dashakTitleEnglish: Swaguna Pariksha (An Examination of One’s Own Nature)
note: All 10 samas are fully populated and sourced. Original owi text and Marathi meaning from the ioustotra.blogspot.com 'Stotra (hymns)' blog (Prakash Ketkar); English meaning from John Norwell's 2015 translation. Every samas's owi count matches exactly between both independent sources with no gaps, duplicates, or numbering shifts. Some samas restate the owi number as a leading list marker inside Norwell’s own English paragraph (e.g. "45. This all became...") - this leading number was stripped since it duplicates the verseNumber field.

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Janma Dukha Nirupan (A Discourse on the Suffering of Birth)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: जन्म दुःखाचा अंकुर । जन्म शोकाचा सागर । जन्म भयाचा डोंगर । चळेना ऐसा ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जन्म हा दुःखरुपी वृक्षाचा अंकुर आहे. जसा जसा हा अंकुर वाढतो, म्हणजेच वृक्ष होतो तसे तसे दुःखही वाढत जाते. जन्म हा शोकाचा सागर आहे. समुद्र हा जसा नेहमी भरलेला असतो, तसेच मानसाचे जीवन दुःखांनी नेहमी भरलेलेच असते. जन्म हा भय भीतिचा डोंगर आहे. डोंगराप्रमाणेच भय पण हालत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Birth is the sprout of suffering. Birth is the ocean of sorrow. Birth is the mountain of fear which does not slip aside.

owis.original: जन्म कर्माची आटणी । जन्म पातकाची खाणी । जन्म काळाची जाचणी । निच नवी ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जन्म हा केलेल्या कर्माचे फलित आहे. केलेल्या कर्माचा कांही भाग कर्मफलाच्या रुपाने भोगण्यासाठी जन्म आहे. जन्म हे पाप आहे. ईश्र्वराला विसरुन दृश्याच्या ओढीने केलेले कर्म दुःख सुरु करणारे होते. जन्म म्हणजे काळाचा जाच होय. काळ दृश्यामध्ये बदल करतअसतो, असा नवीन बदल व नवा नाश हे काळ घडवून आणत असतो. म्हणजे काळाचा जाचच असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Birth is the treadmill of action. Birth is the origin of sin. Birth is the harassment of that ever constant and new Self by the sands of time.

owis.original: जन्म कुविद्येचे फळ । जन्म लोभाचें कमळ । जन्म भ्रांतीचें पडळ । ज्ञानहीन ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जन्म हा कुविद्येने (अज्ञानाने मागील जन्मी) जगल्यामुळे होतो. लोभाचे (आसक्ति) फलित जन्म आहे. वासनांच्या आसक्तिमुळे, ज्ञानहीन जगल्यामुळे भ्रांतींतच जीव राहतो व परत जन्म घ्यावा लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Birth is the fruit of misunderstanding. Birth is the greed of *lord brahma. Birth is the veil of delusion, void of knowledge. *(brahma is the buddhi/intellect, it wants to make/name `many' things)

owis.original: जन्म जिवासी बंधन । जन्म मृत्यासी कारण । जन्म हेंचि अकारण । गथागोवी ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जन्म म्हणजे जीवाचे बंधन आहे. जन्मामुळे देहप्राप्ती व त्यामुळे देहाच्या सुख-दुःखरुपी मर्यादा यामुळे जीवास बंधन होते. जन्म झाला म्हणजे मृत्यु येणारच. जन्मामुळे जीवाचा ईश्र्वराशी असलेला संबंध तुटतो व नाशीवंत देहाशी संबंध येतो व देहाच्या सुख-दुःखांत तो अडकतो, यामुळे जन्म जीवाच्या गुरफटण्यास कारण होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Birth is the binding to a jiva. Birth is the cause of death. Birth is an entanglement for that thoughtless and causeless swarup.

owis.original: जन्म सुखाचा विसर । जन्म चिंतेचा आगर । जन्म वासनाविस्तार । विस्तारला ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जीव ईश्र्वराला विसरल्यामुळे जन्माबरोबर सुखाचाही विसर व चिंतेचा मोठा डोंगर. जीवाची सुख मिळवण्याची धडपड त्याला चिंतेच्या खाईंत लोटते. सुखाच्या धडपडीने निरनिराळ्या वासनांच्या जाळ्यांतून वासना वाढतच जातात.
owis.englishMeaning: Birth is the forgetting of happiness.1 Birth is a storehouse of worries. Birth is the expansion of this expanded vasana to be. 1 siddharameshwar maharaj- This worldly living is full of misery and the one who believes that there is happiness in it and acquires expertise in it, is a fool. Therefore foolishness is the cleverness and expertise of worldly existence.

owis.original: जन्म जिवाची आवदसा । जन्म कल्पनेचा ठसा । जन्म लांवेंचा वळसा । ममतारुप ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जन्म जीवाला मी ईश्र्वर आहे ह्या कल्पनेपासून मी देह आहे या कल्पनेवर आणून त्याचे अधःपतन करतो. जन्म म्हणजे मी देहही ममतारुपी डाकिण त्याला अज्ञानांतच ठेवते किंबहुना अज्ञान वाढवते.
owis.englishMeaning: Birth is the misfortune of the jiva. Birth is the casting mould of imagination ("I am a man and this is a woman"). Birth is the embrace of that passionate woman, in the form of my-ness.

owis.original: जन्म मायेचें मैंदावें । जन्म क्रोधाचें विरावें । जन्म मोक्षास आडवें । विघ्न आहे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जन्म म्हणजे मायेने निर्माण केलेली देहबुद्धि म्हणजेच कपट होय. जन्म हे क्रोधाचे फलित होय. जन्मामुळे जीवास मोक्ष मिळविण्याव्या मार्गांतील विघ्न आहे. मायेमुळे देहबुद्धि व देहबुद्धिमुळे अज्ञान व अज्ञानाने मोक्ष नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Birth is the deception of maya. Birth is a covering of anger. Birth is the hindrance that obstructs liberation.

owis.original: जन्म जिवाचें मीपण । जन्म अहंतेचा गुण । जन्म हेंचि विस्मरण । ईश्र्वराचें ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जन्म हा जीवास मी-मी असे मीपण देतो. जन्म अहकांर देतो. तसाच जन्म हा जीवाला ईश्र्वराचे विस्मरण देतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Birth is the I-ness of the jiva. Birth is the gunas of this "I am a body" thought. Birth is the forgetting of that thoughtless understanding of that purush.

owis.original: जन्म विषयांची आवडी । जन्म दुराशेची बेडी । जन्म काळाची कांकडी । भक्षिताहे ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जन्म हा जीवांत देहबुद्धि निर्माण करत असल्याने विषयांची आवड निर्माण करतो. कधीही तृप्त न होणार्‍या वासनांच्यामुळे चुकीच्या आशा व त्यांची बेडी जीवाच्या भोवती पडते. माणसाने काकडी खाणे जितके त्यास सोपे तसेच काळाला माणसाचे शरीर खाणे सहज सोपे असते.
owis.englishMeaning: Birth is the fondness for sense objects. Birth is the chains of hope. Birth is the devouring of that thoughtless Self in the consuming flames of time.

owis.original: जन्म हाचि विषम काळ । जन्म हेचि वोखटी वेळ । जन्म हा अति कुश्र्चीळ । नर्कपतन ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जन्म हा वाईट काळ, वाईट वेळ व दुःखरुपी नरकांत पडणे होय. हे सर्व का तर जीव हा जन्मामुळे ईश्र्वराला विसरतो, देहबुद्धिला धरुन जगतो व त्यामुळे त्याला दुःखातच राहावे लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: Birth is when that thoughtless Self becomes this `all' and then a body. Birth is when that thoughtless Self becomes the `many' false and painful periods of life. Birth is when that thoughtless Self falls into the most filthy of hells (ie. hell is body consciousness).

owis.original: पाहातां शरीराचें मूळ । या ऐसें नाहीं अमंगळ । रजस्वलेचा जो विटाळ । त्यामध्यें जन्म यासी ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शरीराचे मूळ शोधले तर त्यासारखे अमंगळ काहीच नाही, असे वाटेल. स्त्रीच्या विटाळापासून शरीर तयार होते.
owis.englishMeaning: When you understand this root of `I am' then, there is this `speech' and this is neither painful nor filthy. But that atma purush has become this menstrual fluid and in that, this `I am' takes a birth in a body. (There is nothing but you, that Reality. However on account of your ignorance of your Self, a world outside of yourself is imagined and you have become a little body of flesh and blood. Then that Reality becomes a stinking hell of menstrual fluid etc. etc).

owis.original: अत्यंत दोष ज्या विटाळा । त्या विटाळाचाचि पुतळा । तेथें निर्मळपणाचा सोहळा । केवी घडे ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अतिशय अशुद्ध असा विटाळाचा हा देह. त्याला कितीही शुद्ध करु म्हटले तरी तो शुद्ध होणे कठीण.
owis.englishMeaning: When that atma purush becomes this filthy structure made from the discharge of menstruation then, how can it ever understand that great joy of being the pure brahman?

owis.original: रजस्वलेचा जो विटाळ । त्याचा आळोन जाला गाळ । त्या गाळाचेंच केवळ । शरीर हें ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्त्रीचा विटाळ दाट होऊन आळला की त्याचेच शरीर तयार होते.
owis.englishMeaning: That purush has become the menstrual fluid of the woman (there is only He in this world, even shit is that Reality; but when He forgets Himself there is this objectifi- cation); that atma has become this thickened mire. But truly, this body of mire is that thoughtless pure Self.

owis.original: वरिवरि दिसे वैभवाचें । अंतरीं पोतडें नर्काचें । जैसें झांकणे चर्मकुंडाचें । उघडितांच नये ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शरीर वरवर सुंदर दिसले तरी ते एक घाणीने भरलेले पोतेच असते. चांभाराची कातडी पोतडी जशी दुर्गंधयुक्त असते, ती उघडूच नये पण उघडली तर त्या घाणीने, दुर्गंधीने पळून जावेसे वाटते.
owis.englishMeaning: But that splendour of the atma within this inner space has appeared as a bag of filth. It has become like a tanner's steeping pot and should not even be opened.

owis.original: कुंड धुतां शुद्ध होतें । यास प्रत्यईं धुईजेतें । तरी दुर्गंधी देहातें । शुद्धता नये ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कुंड धुतले तर स्वच्छ होते, देहाला मात्र रोज धुतला (रोज आपण आंघोळ करतोच) तरी त्याची दुर्गंधीने, घाणीने भरलेले शरीर शुद्ध होत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Even that tanner's pot is clean when washed out but when this `I am' becomes a foul smelling body then, even if washed continually still, it can never be clean.

owis.original: अस्तीपंजर उभविला । सीरानाडीं गुंडाळिला । मेदमांसे सरसाविला । सांदोसांदीं भरुनी ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह कसा तयार झाला ? तर हाडांचा सापळा उभा केला, तो शिरा, नाड्या यांनी गुंडाळला, सांध्यासांध्यांत चरबी व मांस भरले व देह तयार झाला.
owis.englishMeaning: This body is a skeleton, erected and tied up with arteries and veins and covered over with fat and flesh.

owis.original: अशुद्ध शब्दें शुद्ध नाहीं । तेंहि भरले असे देहीं । नाना व्याधी दुःखें तेहि। अभ्यांतरी वसती ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रक्त अशुद्ध ते शुद्ध नसतेच, ते देहांत भरले, निरनिराळे रोग व दुःखे यांनीही या देहांत राहावयास जागा केली आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: This impure body cannot be this pure `word' and yet this gross body is filled to the brim, with that Reality. Even when there are the `many' sorrows and diseases still, that Reality resides within the body.2

owis.original: नर्काचें कोठार भरलें । आंत बाहेरी लिडीबिडिलें । मूत्रपोतडे जमलें । दुर्गंधीचें ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शरीर म्हणजे आंतून बाहेरुन घाणीने भरलेले, लडबडलेले नरकाचे कोठारच आहे. मूत्राने भरलेले दुर्गंधीचे पोतडेच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: This body is a storehouse of filth and faeces and that which is inside gets smeared on the *outside. It is but a bag of urine and a collection of foul smells. *(The outside is a product of the inside) (maharaj- you say, so handsome, but if it gets cut with a knife you cannot bare even to look at it)

owis.original: जंत किडे आणी आंतडी । नाना दुर्गंधीची पोतडी । अमुप लवथविती कातडी । कांटाळवाणी ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शरीरांत जंत व किडे आहेत. आतडी घाणीने भरलेली दुर्गंधाची पोती व घाणेरडी कातडी सगळीकडे लोंबत असते.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this bag there are intestinal worms, microscopic creatures and entrails. The `many' (ie. when that One Self gets divided up on account of objectification; body consciousness) is a bag of bad smells and that immeasurable paramatma has been covered over with a hide of skin.

owis.original: सर्वांगास सिर प्रमाण । तेथें बळसें वाहे घ्राण । उठे घाणी फुटतां श्रवण । ते दुर्गंधी ने घवे ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शरीरांतील सर्वांत श्रेष्ठ भाग म्हणजे डोके. पण तेथेही नाकांतून शेंबुड येतो. कान फुटले तर असह्य दुर्गंधी येते.
owis.englishMeaning: To this `all' body, there has come a head (but this `I am' has no head and is without parts) and to that established Truth `there', there has come a nose full of mucus (objectification brings body consciousness and then the One becomes these `many' parts). When listening/shravan is broken and this `I am' is not heard then, a foul odour arises and in this obnoxious smell that Reality cannot be understood. (Once a shishya was travelling with ranjit maharaj on the bus. They passed by a foul smelling sewer and the shishya put his hand to his nose. maharaj said, `What happened'. `That bad smell, maharaj'. maharaj replied, `In paramatma there is no bad smell')

owis.original: डोळां निघती चिपडें । नाकीं दाटतीं मेकडें । प्रातःकाळीं घाणी पडे । मुखीं मळासारिखी ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: डोळ्यांतून चिपाडें निघतात, नाकामध्यें मेंकडे होतात, सकाळी तोंडांतून घाण बाहेर पडते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is pus in the eyes and a nose that is full of mucus and then this *dawn of your Self, has become a foul smell emanating from the mouth. *(You are the dawn; 2sadachar- This body is extremely dirty yet that which is within the body is extremely pure. `I am not the body, I am the unattached Self.' That experience is your purification. maharaj- in the morning when you awake you feel, `Ah, I am there' and then `many' thoughts come; maharaj- in the morning when you awake, this light shines from within you)

owis.original: लाळ थुंका आणी मळ । पीत श्र्लेष्मा प्रबळ । तयास म्हणती मुखकमळ । चंद्रासारिखें ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तोंडांत लाळ, थुंकी, इतर घाण, नाकांत पिवळा शेंबुड, आणि अशा मुखाला कमळची व चंद्राची उपमा देतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that powerful and mighty atma is this saliva, sputum, dirt, bile and mucus. And they compare this to the `face of a lotus' and say, "It resembles the moon"!!

owis.original: मुख ऐसे कुश्र्चीळ दिसे । पोटीं विष्टा भरली असे । प्रत्यक्षास प्रमाण नसे । भूमंडळीं ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मुख असे घाणेरडे तर पोटांत विष्टा, मूत्र भरलेले; हे प्रत्यक्ष प्रमाणच या जगती आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this beautiful form, `I am everywhere', appears as this filthy form with a belly and intestines full of shit. Tell me, how can that established Truth that is within this world, appear to these organs of perception? (The eyes cannot see the Truth, they can only see that which is not true)

owis.original: पोटीं घालितां दिव्यान्न । कांहीं विष्टा कांहीं वमन । भागीरथीचें घेता जीवन । त्याची होये लघुशंका ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चांगले अन्न खाल्ले तरी काहीची विष्टा होते, तर काही ओकून पडते. गंगेचे पवित्र पाणी प्यायले तरी त्याचे मूत्र बनते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this divine food of `I am' is tossed into a belly and then this `all' becomes faeces and this `all' becomes vomit. Then this water of the bhagirathi (pure ganga of knowledge) is taken and made into urine. (When we give up this `all' understanding then, we become the functions of this gross body; then this bliss of `I am', our essential food, becomes the food we eat through our mouth only and in the morning we go to the toilet to discard this and all the time forgetting our true nature)

owis.original: एवं मळ मूत्र आणी वमन । हेंचि देहाचें जीवन । येणेंचि देह वाढे जाण । यदर्थी संशय नाहीं ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: याप्रमाणे मळ, मूत्र आणि ओकारी हेच एकंदरींत जीवन व याप्राकारेच देह वाढतो, यांत संशय नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that thoughtless swarup is this excrement, urine and vomit but, in truth, that swarup is the giver of life to this body. Know that the body grows on account of that Self and keep that conviction.

owis.original: पोटीं नस्तां मळ मूत्र वोक । मरोन जाती सकळ लोक । जाला राव अथवा रंक । पोटीं विष्टा चुकेना ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मळ, मूत्र व ओक पोटांत नसतील तर सगळे लोक मरुन जातील. राजा असो श्रीमंत असो पोटांत विष्टा असतेच असते.
owis.englishMeaning: But if in the belly there is no excrement, urine or vomit then, this body would die and along with this, this world of the `all' would be destroyed (this `all' is the support of this gross body and this gross body is needed to know this `all'. They are inextricably linked and therefore this body requires sustainance; but one should understand, `I eat for this body only.' However taking yourself to be a body, if you sleep or die then, this `I am' also disappears. Therefore, if you use this body to investigate, "Who am I?" then, life will have meaning). So whether you are a king or a beggar, still this shit in the belly is required.

owis.original: निर्मळपणें काढूं जातां । तरी देह पडेल तत्त्वता । एवं देहाची वेवरता । ऐसी असे ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ही सर्व घाण शरीरांतून काढून स्वच्छ केले तर देह टिकणार नाही. तो मरुन जाईल. अशी देहाची व्यवस्था असते.
owis.englishMeaning: If all this excrement, urine and vomit was cleaned out and removed then, the body would surely drop down dead; such is the nature of this arrangement with the body.

owis.original: ऐसा हा धड असतां । येथाभूत पाहों जातां । मग ते दुर्दशा सांगतां । शंका बाधी ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह धड असतांना वर्णन केल्याप्रमाणे देहाचे घणेरडेपण सांगितले, ते खरे वाटत नाही, आणि खरच इतका घाणेरडा देह आहे कां ? अशी शंका मनांत येते.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way, that shapeless has become a shape. Therefore through vivek try to understand how `here'/mula maya has become these great elements and then you can understand that this false state that is possessed of fears and doubts, is truly that Reality (being ourselves that thoughtless, shapeless Reality; due to misunderstanding and lack of vivek, we have taken ourselves to be a body and imprisoned ourselves in the concepts of pain and pleasure. We take this one pure continuous experience `I am' and turn it into a series of `many' different experiences. We suffer the pains of the womb, birth, samsar, die and do it all over again).

owis.original: ऐसिये कारागृहीं वस्ती । नवमास बहु विपत्ती । नवहि द्वारें निरोधती । वायो कैंचा तेथें ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा या तुरुंगांत देह राहात असल्याने (जन्मापूर्विंचे) नऊ महिने फार आपत्तीतून देहास जावे लागते. गर्भाशयांत वायु नसल्याने गर्भाची नवद्वारे- २ डोळे, २ कान, २ नाकपुड्या, तोंड, गुद व उपस्थ ही बंद असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Otherwise that thoughtless will live in this prison and suffer for nine months. When the nine openings of the body (two eyes, two ears, two nostrils, mouth, urethra and anus) have all been blocked off, then how can this wind be `there'? (When this power or wind or knowledge that pervades this whole creation is trapped within the confines of a small body and cannot move outside then, how can understanding possibly come? How can this wind pervade everywhere? We each enter this world in ignorance but only in this world can that ignorance be abandoned)

owis.original: वोका नरकाचे रस झिरपती । ते जठराग्नीस्तव तापती । तेणें सर्वहि उकडती । अस्तिमांस ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मातेच्या पोटांतील ओका, विष्टा यांची घाण जठरांतील उष्णतेने गरम होते व गर्भाचे मांस, हाडे उकडून निघतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The juices that comes from the vomit and excrement gets decanted in the burning gastric fires of the mother's belly and this makes that thoughtless Self so agitated (the embryo in the womb is that thoughtless Reality taking a birth; such is this tragedy of life). On account of this agitation, this `all' body gets covered in bones and flesh (when there is such torment, this `all' gets drowned in agitation and fears and that Self takes itself to be this body of a child).

owis.original: त्वचेविण गर्भ खोळे । तव मातेसी होती डोहळे । कटवतिक्षणें सर्वांग पोळे । तया बाळकाचें ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गर्भाला त्वचा नसते, पातळ खोळींत मातेच्या खाण्याने विशेषतः डोहाळी लागल्यावर तिखट, आंबट, कडू अशा खाण्याने बाळाचे सर्वांग पोळून निघते.
owis.englishMeaning: The wall of the womb is without skin and thus the longings and appetites of the mo- ther are experienced by the child and this `I am' feeling becomes the burning sensations of bitter and pungent tastes the mother has consumed (this `I am' feeling gets covered over by strange and new sensations).

owis.original: बांधलें चर्माचें मोटाळें । तेथें विष्ठेचें पेटाळें । रसउपाय वंकनाळें । होत असे ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गर्भ म्हणजे चामड्यांत गुंडाळलेले गाठोडे असते. तेथेच (मातेच्या देहांतील विष्टेनी भरलेले (आतडयांचे) वेटोळे असते. गर्भाच्या नाळामधून त्याला हवे असलेले रस, पोषक द्रवे मिळतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Everything has been gathered together and wrapped up in this bag of skin and so `there' (ie. brahman) has become a belly full of excrement. And this remedy of the `all' has become a curved and greasy umbilical cord (that which is without parts, has become a mind and body with `many' different parts, due to lifetimes of objectification. How can this `all' be realised in the womb if one has become so objective?).

owis.original: विष्ठा मूत्र वांती पीत । नाकीं तोंडीं निघती जंत । तेणें निर्बुजलें चित्त । आतिशयेंसीं ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मळ, मूत्र, ओक व पित्त यामुळे नाकातोडांतून जंत बाहेर येतात, त्यामुळे गर्भाचा जीव फार घाबराघुबरा होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is excrement, urine, undigested food and bile and tiny organisms appear in the nose and mouth; then that Reality has become a mind, completely confused and very frightened.

owis.original: ऐसिये कारागृहीं प्राणी । पडिला अत्यंत दाटणीं । कळवळोन म्हणे चक्रपाणी । सोडवीं येथून आतां ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा तुरुंगांत पडलेला तो जीव देवाला कळवळून सांगतो की, देवा आतां येथुन सोडव.
owis.englishMeaning: Like this it is for that thoughtless swarup imprisoned within the prana. That has fallen into so much confinement and while writhing in this agony it says, "vishnu (the one who protects) please release me from this maya, now". (At this moment, we are that swarup imprisoned in the prana and at this moment too, that thoughtless swarup pleads for release)

owis.original: देवा सोडविसी येथून । तरी मी स्वहित करीन । गर्भवास हा चुकवीन । पुन्हां न ये येथें ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवा, तूं येथून मला सोडवलसे तर मी माझे भले करीन आणी हा परत गर्भवास चुकवीन. परत येथे येणार नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: "God, if you release me from this maya then, I will do that which is my own Self-benefit. Then that thoughtless Self will avoid another womb and I will never have to come in maya again." (This is our present condition, confined in the prana. How many times have we taken birth? How many times have we been told that we are that thoughtless Reality? How many times have we promised, this will be the last time we will take a birth in the womb?)

owis.original: ऐसी दुखवोन प्रतिज्ञा केली । तंव जन्मवेळ पुढें आली । माता आक्रंदों लागली । प्रसूतकाळीं ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशी अती दुःख झाल्याने प्रतिज्ञा केली. आतां जन्म घेण्याची वेळ जवळ आली. प्रसूतीच्या वेदनांनी आई ओरडू लागली.
owis.englishMeaning: This oath had been made because there was so much suffering (maharaj- why are there so many Saints in India? Because there is so much suffering). Then afterwards there came the time of *birth and the mother cried out loudly in pain (our real mother is actually mula maya, this `all', but due to ignorance and objectivity, she has become this gross body bearing a child and suffering the pains of child birth). *(Yet despite making this oath to God so many times, in so many lives, still we hold on to body consciousness and again find ourselves in the womb of another mother)

owis.original: नाकीं तोंडीं बैसलें मांस । मस्तकद्बारें सांडी स्वास । तेंहि बुजलें निशेष । जन्मकाळीं ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जन्मवेळीं गर्भाच्या नाकातोंडावर मांस बसले. डोक्यावरील टाळू मधुन श्र्वास घेऊ लागला तर तेही बुजले.
owis.englishMeaning: Because the nose and mouth are covered over with fleshy skin, the fetus is not able to breathe and so that Reality is completely filled with fear at this time of birth. (maharaj- that Reality is within the body)

owis.original: मस्तकद्वार तें बुजलें । तेणें चित्त निर्बुजलें । प्राणी तळमळूं लागलें । चहूंकडे ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मस्तकाचे टाळूचे द्वारपण बुजल्याने बाळाचा जीव घाबरा झाला. तो श्र्वासाविना तळमळु लागला.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to these openings of the nose and mouth being blocked off, that Reality is a mind full of fear. And everywhere in the prana there is mental anxiety and physical restlessness.

owis.original: स्वास उस्वास कोंडला । तेणें प्राणी जाजावला । मार्ग दिसेनासा जाला । कासावीस॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्र्वासोश्र्वास कोंडल्याने व बाहेर पडायचा मार्ग पण दिसेनासा झाल्याने बाळ कासावीस झाला.
owis.englishMeaning: That foetus cannot breathe in nor breathe out and that Reality within this prana is terrified. And because a way out through the uterus cannot be found, there is so much distress. (When there is so much distress how can there be vivek now?)

owis.original: चित्त बहु निर्बुजलें । तेणें आडभरी भरलें । लोक म्हणती आडवें आलें । खांडून काढा ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कासावीस झालेले ते बालक बाहेर येण्याची धडपड करता करता भलतीकडेच अडकले. लोक म्हणू लागले की, आडवे आले म्हणून तुकडे करुन बाहेर काढा.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is a mind full of `many' fears then, that Reality is completely covered over. Then the people say, "The child has obstructed. It will have to be cut into pieces to get it out."

owis.original: मग ते खांडून काढिती । हस्तपाद छेदून घेती । हातां पडिले तेंचि कापिती । मुख नासिक उदर ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मग ते बाळाचे हातपाय , तसेच तोंड, नाक, पोट जे अवयव सापडतील ते कापून काढतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that Reality gets cut in pieces and removed. Hands and feet are sliced and taken out. If an arm appears then it is cut and removed. Or the mouth, the nose or the abdomen, whatever can be reached.

owis.original: ऐसे टवके तोडिले । बाळकें प्राण सोडिले । मातेनेंहि सांडिलें । कळिवर ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशी कापाकाप झाल्यावर बाळाने प्राण सोडला. आईनेही देह टाकला.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way, it was cut into pieces and the child losses its life and the mother also becomes a corpse.

owis.original: मृत्य पावला आपण । मातेचा घेतला प्राण । दुःख भोगिलें दारुण । गर्भवासीं ॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशाप्रकारे तो जीव मेला व त्याने आईचाही जीव घेतला. ह्याशिवाय गर्भवासाचे दारुण दुःख भोगलेच.
owis.englishMeaning: The child died and the prana of the mother was also taken away. Really there are so many suffering for the one staying in the womb.

owis.original: तथापी सुकृतेंकरुनी । मार्ग सांपडला योनी । तर्‍हीं आडकला जाउनी । कंठ स्कंदी मागुता ॥ ४४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: यदाकादाचित जन्मवेळी बाहेर येण्यासाठी जीवाला योनी मार्ग सांपडलांच तर त्या लहान मार्गांतून बाहेर येतांना गळा, खांदा वगैरे कोठेतरी अडकतेच.
owis.englishMeaning: However if the child is fortunate and a way through the uterus is found, still there is the constriction of the head and shoulders.

owis.original: तये संकोचित पंथीं । बळेंचि वोढून काढिती । तेणे गुणें प्राण जाती । बाळकाचे ॥ ४५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मग त्या अरुंद मार्गांतून बाळाला ओढून बाहेर काढतात. त्यामुळे बाळाचे प्राण जातात.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way, that Reality was confined and then after tremendous effort the child is brought out. Due to this, there are these mixed gunas of body consciousness and the prana of the child goes outside (see V.8; birth is the gunas of this "I am a body" thought and these bring ignorance and objectification; then the child takes birth and the prana starts to move out and in).

owis.original: बाळकाचे जातां प्राण । अंतीं होये विस्मरण । तेणें पूर्वील स्मरण । विसरोन गेला ॥ ४६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जन्माला येण्याच्यावेळी जीव भगवंताची आठवण विसरुन जातो. त्यामुळे प्राण गेल्यावर, गर्भांत असतांना भगवंताची केलेली विनवणी विसरतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The prana of the child went outside and as a consequence of this there is forget- ting (in the prana the tamo guna of ignorance/forgetting manifests) and any previous memories are forgotten by that Reality in the prana (see V.8; birth is the forgetting of that thoughtless understanding of the purush).

owis.original: गर्भी म्हणे सोहं सोहं । बाहेरी पडतां म्हणे कोहं । ऐसा कष्टी जाला बहु । गर्भवासीं ॥ ४७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गर्भांत असतांना जीव सोहं सोह ( मी परमेश्र्वर आहे) म्हणत असतो. तर जन्म घेतांना बाहेर पडतांना मी कोण मी कोण असे म्हणणारा जीव गर्भवासाच्या यातनांनी दुःखी होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: so-ham, so-ham/ `I am He, I am He' is being said within but on the outside that cannot be heard and one says, ko-ham, ko-ham/ "Who am I, Who am I?" due to the guna of ignorance. Then there are the `many' sufferings in the continuous rounds of birth. (The foetus does not say so-ham, it is in the torment of the gunas, how can it understand? But within it and every living creature this so-ham is ever present)

owis.original: दुःखा वरपडा होता जाला । थोरा कष्टीं बाहेरी आला । सवेंच कष्ट विसरला । गर्भवासाचे ॥ ४८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गर्भवासाच्या यातनांतून सुटुन मोठ्या कष्टाने बाहेर आला, आणि गर्भवासाचे दुःख, यातना विसरला.
owis.englishMeaning: That Self (the child is He) had gone through so much misery and suffered terribly on the way out. But immediately and quite naturally, that suffering of the womb is forgotten (due to the ignorance of tamo guna).

owis.original: सुंन्याकार जाली वृत्ती । कांहीं आठवेना चित्तीं । अज्ञानें पडिली भ्रांती । तेणें सुखचि मानिलें ॥ ४९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मन शून्याकार झाले. पूर्विंचे कांही (गर्भवासाचे दुःख )आठवेना. अज्ञानाचे आवरण मनावर पडून भ्रांत अवस्था झाली. जीव आतां तेच सुख मानू लागला.
owis.englishMeaning: This *vritti is lost when knowledge is not remembered in the mind (ie. this remem- bering is forgetting everything). Due to ignorance, that Reality has fallen into delusion and then one imagines that the stay in the womb was pleasurable (Knowledge/sattwa guna and ignorance/tamo guna mix together to bring rajo guna ie. imagination. Such is one's stay in the prana. But how can this knowledge be realized without forgetting everything?). *(Desire to know)

owis.original: देह विकार पावलें । सुखदुःखें झळंबलें । असो ऐसें गुंडाळलें । मायाजाळीं ॥ ५० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहाचे विकार मागे लागले. सुख-दुःखाचे खेळ सुरु झाले. अशारीतीने मायेच्या जाळ्यांत जीव अडकला.
owis.englishMeaning: This modification `I am' has acquired a body and then it is subjected to pleasures and pains. Like this is the entanglement in the net of maya.

owis.original: ऐसें दुःख गर्भवासीं । होतें प्राणीामात्रासीं । म्हणोनियां भगवंतासी । शरण जावें ॥ ५१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असे गर्भवासी असतांना प्राणीमात्रांनादुःख, यातना होतात. म्हणून भगवंताला शरण जावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Such are the sufferings in the womb and then that One appears in the prana. Therefore you should surrender to God.

owis.original: जो भगवंताचा भक्त । तो जन्मापासून मुक्त । ज्ञानबळें विरक्त । सर्वकाळ ॥ ५२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो भगवंताचा भक्त असतो, तो जन्मापासून मुक्त होतो. आत्मज्ञान झाल्याने तो सर्वकाळ विरक्त असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The one who is a devotee of God is freed from these sufferings of birth for this power of knowledge brings dispassion and that brings this time of the `all' (liberation from the feeling "I am a body of flesh and blood").

owis.original: ऐशा गर्भवासीं विपत्ती । निरोपिल्या येथामती । सावध होऊन श्रोतीं । पुढें अवधान द्यावें ॥ ५३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा गर्भावस्थेंतील आपत्तीचें, दुःखाचे वर्णन मला जमले तसे केले. श्रोत्यांनी सावधपणे पुढिल भागाकडे लक्ष द्यावे.
owis.englishMeaning: The sufferings for the one in the womb occur because we stubbornly hold on to body identification. Therefore the true listener should be alert and ahead, give their full attention to this `I am' feeling by forgetting everything. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Swaguna Pariksha A (An Examination of One’s Own Nature, Part A)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: संसार हाचि दुःखमूळ । लागती दुःखाचे इंगळ । मागां बोलिली तळमळ । गर्भवासाची ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: संसार हाच दुःखाचे मूळ आहे. जन्म झाला की, दुःखाचे इंगळ जाणवू लागतात. मागल्या समासांत गर्भवासांतील यातनाचें वर्णन केले.
owis.englishMeaning: That thoughtlessness, I do not exist, has become this worldly life/samsar and this is the source of all miseries. Then that One has to suffer the pains of the scorpion's stings (ie. desires). Then this previous `speech' (so-ham, `I am He') has become the anxiety and suffering in these continuous rounds of taking birth (ko-ham, "Who am I?").

owis.original: गर्भवासी दुःख जालें । ते बाळक विसरलें । पुढें वाढों लागलें । दिवसेंदिवस ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गर्भवासांत जे दुःख झाले ते जन्म होतांच बाळक विसरते. आणि मग दिवसेदिवस ते वाढू लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to the sufferings of the one in the womb, that Reality was forgotten and there appeared this child in the prana (ie. the concept of individuality arose). Afterwards, day by day, that concept began to grow (an newborn infant does not take itself as a body but, day by day, this concept "I am a body" becomes stronger until it gets firmly established).3

owis.original: बाळपणीं त्वचा कोंवळी । दुःख होतांचि तळमळी । वाचा नाहीं तये काळीं । सुखदुःख सांगावया ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लहानपणी त्वचा कोवळी असते. त्यामुळे होणार्‍या यातनानीं ते बाळक तळमळते. बर सुखदुःख सांगायला वाचा नसल्याने होणार्‍या यातना बाळकाला सांगता येत नाहीत.
owis.englishMeaning: When that Reality becomes this infant with soft skin then, it has to suffer so much and is fulled with anxiety. This `speech' is not with the child and body consciousness grows stronger daily and there is this mix of pleasures and pains (a infant does not have the intellect/buddhi capable of vivek and therefore it cannot know this `I am' and so it must endure the sufferings).

owis.original: देहास कांहीं दुःख जालें । अथवा क्षुधेनें पीडलें । तरी तवं परम आक्रंदलें । परी अंतर नेणवे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बाळकाच्या देहाला कांहीं यातना झाल्या किंवा त्याला भूक लागली तर ते मोठ्याने रडते, पण त्याला नक्की काय झाले आहे, हे त्याच्या अंतरीचे मातेला कळत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: This bliss of the `all' has become the pains of the body or the torments of hunger. Then that Supreme Self cries out loudly and this inner space of `I am' cannot be known (On account of its ignorance, that Supreme Self takes itself to be a child and then it suffers and cries; how can this small child understand this `I am'? Only the mind of the one who tires of this samsar and meets the guru can transcend the pains and pleasures, hunger and thirst etc. and know this `all').

owis.original: माता कुरवाळी वरी । परी जे पीडा जाली अंतरी । तें मातेसी न कळे अभ्यांतरीं । दुःख होये बाळकासीं ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माता त्याला कुरवाळते, परंतु बाळकाला अंतरी काय उपद्रव झाला आहे, हे मातेला बाहेरुन कळत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: The mother caresses the child, but this `I am' feeling has become these torments (the mother's caresses cannot sooth the pain caused by our estrangement from this `I am'). If this maya does not understood that Reality within, then there are sure to come the sufferings of an ignorant child. (Birth cannot be avoided by the ignorant. When the understanding `I am' is forgotten then, there is the misunderstanding "I am a body". But if while in this body you seek out understanding/wisdom then, that Reality will not have to take another birth again)

owis.original: मागुतें मागुतें फुंजे रडे । माता बुझावी घेऊन कडे । वेथा नेणती बापुडें । तळमळी जीवीं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तें बाळक हुंदके देऊन रडते. आई त्याला कडेवर घेऊन त्याचे रडणें थांबविण्याचे प्रयत्न करते. पण तीला त्याची नेमकी व्यथा न कळल्याने ते बाळक व्यथेने तळमळतच राहाते.
owis.englishMeaning: It snobs and cries over and over again and its mother holds it and carries it from place to place (we are the children/orphans and maya is our mother and she carries us from one place to another). But if you understand that One atma purush then you will not have to suffer the anguish of this helpless orphan and the worries within the jiva (if you understand that atma purush then, where is the jiva and these sufferings? They are then just like a dream).

owis.original: नाना व्याधीचे उमाळे । तेणें दुःखें आंदोळे । रडे पडे कां पोळे । अग्निसंगे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नाना प्रकारच्या रोगांनी त्या मूलाचा जीव वरखाली होतो. ते मूल पडते, रडते, कधी कधी अग्नीच्या संपर्कांत येऊन पोळते.
owis.englishMeaning: Thoughts arise and bring `many' ailments and when that Reality appears as these painful agitations, there is much crying, falling and grief caused by its company with this fire element (the great elements, space, wind, fire, water and earth are used as metaphors to explain this process of objectification. The nature of objectification will be explained in detail later. But in short, the more gross the elements become the more `real' the world appears. The wind element is the feeling, `Myself is everything, everywhere.' The fire element brings the feeling of something outside of myself. Due to this, one has stepped a little further outside of one's Self and then there comes the feeling of individuality when there is further objectification and the water and earth elements are formed bringing the appearance of individual objects).

owis.original: शरीर रक्षितां नये । घडती नाना अपाये । खोडी अधांतरी होये । आवेवहीन बाळक ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्या मुलाला आपल्या शरीराचे स्वतःला रक्षण करता येत नाही. त्यामुळे निरनिराळ्या प्रकारचे शरीराला अपाय होतात. कधी कधी खोड्या करतां करतां एखादा अवयवसुद्धा गमवावा लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then this `all' body cannot protect one and `many' injures are sustained (when one takes oneself to be a gross body in an objective world then, this refuge of knowledge cannot be known). But in this space, within this defect of the gross body, there is That which is without parts (and perfect; again we have reference to the protecting power of understanding. If while in this body we forget everything then, this knowledge can be understood and then, if this is also left, that Reality can be realized).

owis.original: अथवा अपाय चुकले । पूर्व पुण्य पुढें ठाकलें । मातेस वोळखों लागलें । दिवसेंदिवस ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कधी कधी पूर्व पुण्यायीने अपाय होत नाहीत. दिवसेंदिवस तें बाळक आईला चांगले ओळखू लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: If that harmful thought, "I am a body" is forgotten then, this previous merit of `I am' is acquired and one gradually starts to recognize one's mother (one's true mother is mula maya).

owis.original: क्षणभरी मातेस न देखे । तरी आक्रंदे रुदन करी दुःखें । ते समईं मातेसारिखें । आणीक कांहींच नाहीं ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: क्षणभरसुद्धा माता दिसली नाही तरी दुःखाने रडू लागते. त्या वयांत मातेसारखे दुसरे कांहीही त्याच्या लेखी महत्वाचे नसते.
owis.englishMeaning: But if, for even a moment, this mother is not recognised then, that One cries out loudly with sorrow (ie. "I am a jiva, I want this and that support etc."). And at that time, the knowledge `I am' disappears and there appears this worldly mother (as soon as our real mother is forgotten; as soon as vivek is given up and we stop listening then, there are all these family connections ie. individuality. Then that Reality assumes `many' forms according to the concepts we hold of it. But the young infant like the gnyani does not objectify, it does not know a good man or a bad man etc. However the instant it fears, "I am alone" it acquires body awareness and its real mother ie. mula maya, is forgotten and so it takes the support of this imagined world and a mother of flesh and blood)

owis.original: आस करुन वास पाहे । मातेविण कदा न राहे । वियोग पळमात्र न साहे । स्मरण जालियां नंतरें ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मोठ्या आशेने आईची वाट बघते. आईशिवाय ते कदापि राहू शकत नाही. तीची आठवण झाली की, तीचा वियोग सहन करुं शकत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: With hope it waits expectantly to see its mother, for it cannot remain without her. This separation cannot be endured for even one moment and so it begins to remember (our mother is mula prakruti/maya and without this `I am' we cannot live for even a moment. But she has been forgotten and so we seek the support of remembering ie. imagination. In this way, that Reality gets born alone into this world and then it takes the support of a another and imagines, "My mother").

owis.original: जरी ब्रह्मादिक देव आले । अथवा लक्ष्मीनें अवलोकिलें । तरी नवचे बुझाविलें । आपले मातेवांचुनी ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मदेव आदि देव आले किंवा श्रीलक्ष्मीने बघितलेव बोलावले तरी त्याच्या आईवाचून त्याला कोणीच उगी करु शकत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Then either lord brahma etc. or goddess lakshmi will come to watch over us; but one cannot be pacified without a mother. (If one takes oneself to be a body then, there are the three gunas of brahma etc. and objectification and we imagine, "This is my mother." Or through vivek, lakshmi/`I am' or mula maya becomes our mother. Not understanding that we are that totally independent Reality we seek some support; whether it is this worldly mother or our other mother, this `I am')

owis.original: कुरुप अथवा कुलक्षण । सकळांहूनि करंटेपण । तरी नाहीं तीसमान । भूमंडळीं कोणी ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ती आई कुरुप असो, करंटी असो कशीही असो त्याच्यासाठी ती या पृथ्वीवर असलेली त्याची ती आईच मोठी असते.
owis.englishMeaning: From this `all' has come the misfortune of body consciousness and even though this mother in this mundane existence, is a false form and though she is has a false attention still, like her there is no-one in this world for the child (ie. though this mother is not our true mother and she feels "I am a body"; and though she is a false form still, due to our ignorance, we project our love for our true Self, upon this mother).

owis.original: ऐसें तें केविलवाणें । मातेविण दिसे उणें । रागें परतें केलें तिनें । तरी आक्रंदोनि मिठी घाली ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असे ते बालक मातेशिवाय केविलवाणे होते. ती रागावली तरी परत तीलाच रडतरडत मिठी घालते.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way, that Reality has become a whimpering child and without its real mother, it sees through these eyes of flesh and then a lacking is always felt.4 And if, on account of anger she places the child far away, still it will cry out loudly and embrace her. (We are the children; taking ourselves to be a body, our desires bring anger and `many' emotions and then our true mother places us far from her. Then we cry loudly and embrace these things of the world and we don't want to give them up)

owis.original: सुख पावे मातेजवळी । दुरी करितांचि तळमळी । अति प्रीति तये काळीं । मातेवरी लागली ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ते आईजवळ सुखावते. आईपासून दूर होताच कासाविस होते. त्या वयांत मातेवर त्याचे फार प्रेम असते. मनुष्याच्या लहानपणापासूनच्या निरनिराळ्या अवस्थांचे त्यांत सोसाव्या लागणार्‍या दुःखांचे वर्णन समर्थ येथे करतत आहेत. बालक मोठे होत असतांना त्याची आई मरण पावली तर त्याला काय व कसेदुःख भोगावे लागते त्याचे वर्णन खालीलप्रमाणे केले आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Real happiness is acquired when this mother is near and there is anxiety when each are placed far apart. Then that great love for that Reality within mula maya is placed upon this mother in the gross world.

owis.original: तव ते मातेस मरण आलें । प्राणी पोरटें जालें । दुःखें झुर्णीं लागलें । आई आई म्हणोनी ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आई मरण पावली. मुल पोरके झाले. ते दुःखाने आई-आई म्हणून झुरु लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: At this time, lost in the `many' thoughts, death comes to this mother (ie. mula maya) and there is a child, an orphan in the prana (`Who am I?'). It starts to pine and says, "Mother, mother." (Forgetting this `I am' on account of the `many' thoughts, that One Self takes itself to be a body and then seeks the support of this worldly mother and the `many' other relationships)

owis.original: आई पाहातां दिसेना । दीनरुप पाहे जना । आस लागलिसे मना । आई येईल म्हणोनि ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ते आईला शोधते, दिनवाणे होते, मनाला आस लागुन राहते की आई येईल म्हणुन.
owis.englishMeaning: But, if you understood that this `all' is your mother and she cannot be seen by these eyes then, the mind can understand this subtle form. Though as soon as hope arises in the mind, the child again thinks, "Mother will come". (If we leave these `many' thoughts and imaginations then, our real mother can be perceived. Otherwise there are the constant longings of this world we see through these eyes)

owis.original: माता म्हणौन मुख पाहे । तव ते आपुली माता नव्हे । मग हिंसावले राहे । दैन्यवाणें ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याचे त्याचे तोंड आई म्हणुन पाहते, पण त्याला ही आई नाही म्हणुन समजुन हिरमुसले, दैन्यवाणे होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Mother means, to perceive this `all' form. But in this time of the `many' thoughts, our mother is not this `all' and then we remain a lowly miserable body.

owis.original: मातावियोगें कष्टलें । तेणें मानसीं दुःख जालें । देहहि क्षीणत्व पावलें । आतिशयेंसीं ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मातेच्या वियोगाने दुःखी-कष्टी होते. हळुहळु त्याचा देहही अति अशक्त होऊ लागतो. ज्या बालकाची माता जिवंत असेल त्याचे दुःख काही वेगळेच असते. त्याचे वर्णन खालील ओव्यांत आले आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to our separation from this mother, there is the distress and exhaustion of this world and due to this, suffering arises in the mind. Then finally this body gets completely worn out and we grow old and die.

owis.original: अथवा माताहि वांचली । मायलेंकुरा भेटीं जाली । बाळदशा ते राहिली । दिवसेंदिवस ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माता जिवंत राहुन आईची व बालकाची भेट झाली. तर दिवसेंदिवस त्याचे बालपण सरत जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: But if this mother does not die and continues to exist (the understanding, `Nothing is true' is maintained) then, the mother/maya and her son meet (the mind is her son). Then there is this state of a *child and one will stay as this `all' or knowledge, day after day. *(In the beginning the child sees oneness but ignorance is there; the gnyani also sees oneness but no ignorance is there; maharaj- be like a child. I sees no good and bad... it will piss on the king's lap, it doesn't care)6

owis.original: बाळपण जालें उणें । दिवसेंदिवस होये शाहाणें । मग ते मायेंचें अत्यंत पेरुणें । होतें तें राहिलें ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बालपण हळुहळु सरल्यावर ते बालक शहाणे होते. पूर्वी मातेवर असलेले प्रेम किंवा अवलंबुन राहाणे कमी होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Though there is this `state of a child', still there is the feeling of lacking (knowledge is not that complete contentment of Reality). But with constant alertness this feeling subsides and then day after day more wisdom is gained (if this `state' is constantly guarded then real wisdom will arise). And when mula maya has this extreme longing then, that Reality comes and stays.

owis.original: पुढें लो लागला खेळाचा । कळप मेळविला पोरांचा । आल्यागेल्या डायाचा । आनंद शोक वाहे ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुढे त्याला खेळण्याचा नाद लागतो. ते मुलांना जमवुन खेळु लागते. खेळांत जिंकला तर आनंद व हरला तर दुःख हे जाणवु लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: But if ahead there is a fondness for play then, the child meets with a bunch of other children (they take one stone and say it is a house, they take another stone and say it is a car; in the same way, we imagine so many things). Then there are the comings and goings of this game where bliss and sorrow both flow by (we are the children and this life flows by and we delight in bliss and suffer in sorrow).

owis.original: मायबापें सिकवितीं पोटें । तयाचें परम दुःख वाटे । चट लागली न सुटे । संगती लेंकुरांची ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आई-वडिल मनापासुन शिकवतात ते त्याला आवडत नाही. इतर मुलांना जमवुन खेळण्याची लागलेली सवय सुटत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: The mother/mula maya and father/mula purush try to teach his mind, for that Re- ality is being made to suffer so much. But that One has fondness for the companionship of the children and that cannot be broken.

owis.original: लेंकुरांमध्यें खेळतां । नाठवे माता आणि पिता । तव तेथेंहि अवचिता । दुःख पावला ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मुलांमध्ये खेळतांना आई-वडिलांची आठवण येत नाही. पण तेथेही अचानक दुःख ओढवते.
owis.englishMeaning: And while playing with the children (ie. your thoughts), mother/mula maya and father/mula purush are not remembered. And at that time of body consciousness, `there' is unintentionally made to suffer.

owis.original: पडिले दांत फुटला डोळा । मोडले पाय जाला खुळा । गेला माज अवकळा । ठाकून आली ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खेळतांना दांत पडतात. पाय मोडतो. व लंगडा होतो. मग सगळा माज उतरतो कारण शरीर कुरुप होते.
owis.englishMeaning: He breaks a tooth or loses an eye (or He begrudges another and cannot bare the sight of their success) or he breaks his foot and becomes lame (or he becomes disheartened and incapable of performing his duty ie. to know the Self). His estimation of his own self shrinks and his splendour fades away (the "I am a body" notion brings the feeling of incompletion and inadequacy).

owis.original: निघाल्या देवी आणी गोवर । उठलें कपाळ लागला ज्वर । पोटसुळीं निरंतर । वायगोळा ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवी, गोवर, ताप, कपाळशूळ, पोटदुखी असे आजार जडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: He contracts smallpox or measles. He may get headaches and fevers. Then that One who is beyond this inner space (parabrahman) suffers from stomach ache or flatu- lence (troubles are sure to come to the body, but these troubles are not yours, if you understand).

owis.original: लागलीं भूतें जाली झडपणी । जळीच्या मेसको मायेराणी । मुंज्या झोटिंग करणी । म्हैसोबाची ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: याला भूत लागले, कोणीतरी करणी केली किंवा पाण्यांतील मेसको मायराणीने झपाटले अगर मुंजा, झोटिंग किंवा म्हसोबाने धरले असे लोक म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The people say, "He is possessed by an evil spirit" or "Goddess maya is angry"; or "He is possessed by the spirit of a dead brahmin boy", or "This is all the doings of a ghost."

owis.original: वेताळ खंकाळ लागला । ब्रह्मगिर्‍हो संचरला । नेणों चेडा वोलांडिला । कांहीं कळेना ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी म्हणतात की, वेताळ खंकाळा लागला. तर कोणी ब्रह्मसंमध याला लागला तर कोणी म्हणतात याने काही मंतरलेले ओलांडले असावे पण काहींच समजत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: They say, "It may be the doings of that terrible vetala, the king of ghosts" or "The spirit of a dead brahman has entered him", because we do not leave aside all these thoughts of *sorcery and superstition and this `all' has not been understood. *(Sorcery is our imagination ie. from out of nothing we create something)

owis.original: येक म्हणती वीरेदेव । येक म्हणती खंडेराव । येक म्हणती वाव । हा ब्राह्मणसमधं ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: काहीं म्हणतता वीरेदेव, काहीं म्हणतात खंडेराव तर कांही म्हणतात हे खोटे  याला ब्रह्मसंमध लागल आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that *One says, "The god veera is responsible." The One says, "It is khandoba." The One says, "It was because his inner space was empty that, the dead brahmin's spirit entered inside." *(We ourselves are that One thoughtless Supreme and yet we imagine so many concepts)

owis.original: येक म्हणती कोणें केलें । आंगीं देवत घातलें । येक म्हणती चुकलें । सटवाईचें ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी म्हणतात याचे अंगांत मंत्रशक्तीने कोणीतरी दैवत सोडले आहे. तर कोणी म्हणतात की सटवाईचे काहीं देणे राहीले असावे.
owis.englishMeaning: Or the One says, "Somebody must have induced a deity into his body." The One says, "The goddess satwai had been neglected" (satwai- It is believed that she visits and writes the child's destiny on its forehead when it is born).

owis.original: येक म्हणती कर्मभोग । आंगी जडले नाना रोग । वैद्य पंचाक्षरी चांग । बोलाऊन आणिले ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: काहीं म्हणतात हा कर्मभोग आहे. शरीराला  नाना रोग जडले आहेत म्हणुन वैद्य पंचाक्षरींना बोलवितात.
owis.englishMeaning: Or the One (thoughtless Supreme) says, "This is all the result of past karma." But the truth is that, in this `all' body there has come the disease of body consciousness and that brings so `many' thoughts and so they call for and bring good doctors or good exorcists.

owis.original: येक म्हणती हा वांचेना । येक म्हणती हा मरेना । भोग भोगितो यातना । पापास्तव ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांही म्हणतात हा वाचणार नाही. काहीं म्हणतात हा मरणार  नाही.  मागील जन्मींच्या पापामुळे हा निरनिराळ्या यातना भोगतो आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: One says, "He will not survive" and One says, "No! No! He will not die! But due to the sins created by him in the past, he has to endure these sufferings." (All these concepts are due to our ignorance of our own deathless Self)

owis.original: गर्भदुःख विसरला । तो त्रिविधतापें पोळला । प्राणी बहुत कष्टी जाला । संसारदुःखें ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो बालक गर्भामध्ये असतांना झालेले दुःख विसरला पण जन्मल्यावर संसारदुःखाने दुःखी झाला.
owis.englishMeaning: The pains in the womb had been forgotten (and the promises we made to seek Him) due to tamo guna but now that atma gets burnt by the *three torments and then in the prana, this `all' has to suffer the pains of samsar. *(see 3.6, 7, 8)

owis.original: इतुकेंहि चुकोन वांचला । तरी मारमारुं शाहाणा केला । लोकिकीं नेटका जाला । नाव राखे ऐसा ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: इतके सोसुनही जर वाचला तर त्याला मारुमुटकुन शहाणा केला. घराण्याचे बापाचे नांव लोकांमध्ये राखेल असा नेटका केला.
owis.englishMeaning: These mistakes have to be lived through,8 for it is due to these toils and assaults and beatings that wisdom comes (troubles bring the longing for understanding. How can pleasure take one to that Reality?) Only then will this `I am' be formed and carefully maintained within this worldly existence.

owis.original: पुढें मायेबापीं लोभास्तव । संभ्रमें मांडिला विव्हाव । दाऊनियां सकळ वैभव । नोवरी पाहिली ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुढे आई-बापाने लोभामुळे त्याचा विवाह करण्यासाठी नवरी योजीली.
owis.englishMeaning: But ahead a selfish greed arose in his mother/mula maya within the father/mula purush and then due to this delusion, a marriage was arranged. And though having this understanding and grandeur of the `all', a bride was searched for her son (This `all'/mula maya that is full of grandeur forgets herself and due to attraction/desire, greed etc. becomes body consciousness and seeks the pleasures of this world and the `happiness' of her son. The father/purush is forever indifferent; he is the Witness but then he must go wherever He is lead by this illusion).

owis.original: वर्‍हाडीवैभव दाटलें । देखोन परम सुख वाटलें । मन हे रंगोन गेलें । सासुरवाडीकडे ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विवाहासाठी आपापली ऐट दाखवत वर्‍हाडी जमले.  लग्नाचा थाट, वैभव बघुन नवरदेव खुष झाले.  सासुरवाडीच्या वैभवाने तिकडेच रमले.
owis.englishMeaning: In the *marriage procession this grandeur of the `all' gets puffed up with the pride of "I am so and so". While understanding this `all', that Supreme feels pleasure but the mind has enamoured that thoughtless Self and it goes towards the residence of the in-laws (ie. to a place that is not its own; body consciousness). *(ie. the expansion into worldly activity)

owis.original: मायबापीं भलतैसें असावें । परी सासुरवाडीस नेटकें जावें । द्रव्य नसेल तरी घ्यावें । रुण कळांतरें ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आई-वडिल कसेही का राहीना आपण सासुरवाडीस निटनेटके जावे मग पैसे नसतील तर कर्ज काढावे लागले तरी चालेल.
owis.englishMeaning: Whatever one wants is within this mother and father (mula maya/purush; for there is the understanding, `I am everything, everywhere'), but he goes straight to the place of the bride's family. And though this wealth (ie. the manifestation and objectification of the mind) will get destroyed still, he agrees to take this wealth and the debts and the interest that this will incur (we give up our real wealth of `I am' to have this imagined wealth ie. created by our own concepts, and we take on the debt of body consciousness that is so hard to repay for we become completely enamoured by the attractions and affections of the world).

owis.original: आंतर्भाव ते सासुरवाडीं । मायेबापें राहिलीं बापुडीं । होताती सर्वस्वें कुडकुडीं । तितुकेंच कार्य त्यांचें ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आता जीव सासुरवाडीस लागतो. आई-वडिल बापुडवाणे जीणे जगु लागतात. त्याच्या जीवनांत तेवढेच शिल्लक असते. आता बायकोच्या/कामवासनेच्या आहारी गेलेल्याचे वर्णन खालीलप्रमाणे केले आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When this inner understanding goes to the place of the bride's family then, his mother and father end up in a miserable state. They had grumbled about this `all' and this property and wealth that they already had and this was the outcome of their grumbling (maharaj- you should cherish the joy of this understanding).

owis.original: नोवरी आलियां घरा । अती हव्यास वाटे वरा । म्हणे मजसारिखा दुसरा । कोणीच नाहीं ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बायको घरी आल्यावर सारखी ती त्याला जवळ हवीजवीशी वाटु लागते व माझ्यासारखा दुसरा कोणी सुखी/मोठा नाही असे त्या तरुणाला वाटु लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: When the bride was brought to this house of body consciousness there was intense longing for her. He said, "Surely, there is no other as great as me!" (This `all' has been completely forgotten and the greatness of this is superimposed upon this body and `me')

owis.original: मायबाप बंधु बहिणी । नोवरी न दिसतां वाटे काणी । अत्यंत लोभला पापिणीं । अविद्येनें भुलविला ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बायको घरी नसली तर आि-बाप भाऊ-बहीण घरी असुनही दुःखी होतो व पापी अविद्येने भुलुन जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: The mother/mula maya and father/mula purush, and brother (a mind that is at- tentive) and sisters (devotion) cannot be seen when his affections are for his wife. Thus due to his infatuation with avidya (maya of ignorance, "I am body"), he forgot Himself and there was intense desire and his heart was full of worldly intent.

owis.original: संभोग नस्तां इतुका प्रेमा । योग्य जालिया उलंघी सीमा । प्रीती वाढविती कामा । करितां प्राणी गुंतला ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पत्नी वयांत आली नसतांना इतके प्रेम करतो व मग वयांत आल्यावर संभोगाच्या सर्व सीमांचे उल्लंघन करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Sexual union destroyed any love for that One and after this union his shameless conduct went beyond all bounds. His love made his lust increase and therefore in the prana, he was entangled.

owis.original: जरी न देखे क्षण येक डोळां । तरी जीव होय उताविळा । प्रीतीपात्र अंतर्कळा । घेऊन गेली ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: क्षणभर जरी बायको दिसली नाही तरी त्याचा जीव उताविळा होतो. विवेक विचार सर्व हरवुन बसतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That `moment of the One' cannot be seen through the eyes of flesh and so the jiva has become impatient (these longings of the jiva should be turned into the patient longing to know one's own Self). Therefore understand that, anyone who is the object of one's love takes away this `art of knowing' in the inner space (a jiva looks for that `most beloved' One through the eyes of flesh)

owis.original: कोवळे कोवळे शब्द मंजुळ । मर्यादा लज्या मुखकमळ । वक्त्रलोकनें केवळ । ग्रामज्याचे मैंदावें ॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तिचे गोड बोलणे, ती आदब, मर्यादा, लज्जा, मुखकमळ, ते तिरप्या डोळ्यांनी बघणे, यामुळे कामवासनेने भरुन जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: There was this tender, sweet and gentle `word' `I am' but all shamelessness is cast off for his most beautiful wife. And due to her worldly speech, that pure knowledge becomes a foolish, doting and lustful man.

owis.original: कळवळा येतां सांवरेना । शरीर विकळ आवरेना । अनेत्र वेवसाईं क्रमेना । हुरहुर वाटे ॥ ४४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तिची आठवण झाली की मन आवरता येत नाही. कामवासनेने शरिर ताब्यांत राहात नाही. कामधंद्यांत मन लागत नाही. सारखी तिची हुरहुर लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: If such yearnings come then, you lose all your power; and then this body of the `all' gets agitated and cannot be controlled. Then you are not present in every place (ie. `all'-pervasive) and while conducting your worldly affairs, there are these feelings of sorrow and longing.

owis.original: वेवसाय करितां बाहेरी । मन लागलेंसे घरीं । क्षणक्षणां अभ्यांतरीं । स्मरण होये कामिनीचें ॥ ४५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बाहेर कामधंदा करतांना मन मात्र घरी लागलेले असते. क्षणाक्षणाला बायकोची आठवण येतच असते.
owis.englishMeaning: When you make your business outside then, the mind goes instantly within the house of body consciousness and then every moment in the mind there is the remembrance of your loved ones ("My beautiful wife, I wonder what she is doing?" etc.)

owis.original: तुम्हीं माझिया जिवांतील जीव । म्हणौनि अत्यंत लाघव । दाऊनियां चित्त सर्व । हिरोन घेतलें ॥ ४६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बायकोने त्याला तुम्ही माझ्या जीवाचा जीव म्हणुन अत्यंत लाघवीपणे त्याचे चित्त हिरावुन घेतले.
owis.englishMeaning: "You are the life of my life." By saying this with great sweetness and skill, the chitta (ie. thinking process) that can understand this `all', gets seized and taken away.

owis.original: मैंद सोइरीक काढिती । फांसे घालून प्राण घेती । तैसें आयुष्य गेलियां अंतीं । प्राणीयांस होये ॥ ४७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ठग लोक प्रथम काही नातेसंबंध दाखवुन जवळीक साधतात व योग्य संधी साधुन प्राण घेऊन लुबाडतात. तसेच मरण जवळ आले की माणसाची दशा होते.
owis.englishMeaning: There are gangs who murder and steal from travellers. First they make friends with them and then they choke them. This lifetime passes by in the same way and then finally ends for the one entangled in the prana.

owis.original: प्रीति कामिनीसीं लागली । जरी तयेसी कोणी रागेजलीं । तरी परम क्षिती वाटली । मानसीं गुप्तरुपें ॥ ४८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बायकोवर अति प्रेम जडते. तिलाकोणी रागावुन बोलीले तर फार वाईट वाटते. तसे बाहेर मात्र बोलुन दाखविता येत नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: That One gave his love to his beloved wife and then, if anyone became angry with her, that Supreme felt silently insulted in his mind (ie. "me and mine"; "She is mine" you say, but in truth, no-one is there other than your own Self).10 (maharaj- the Reality cares for no-one)

owis.original: तये भार्येचेनि कैवारें । मायेबापासीं नीच उत्तरें । बोलोनियां तिरस्कारें । वेगळा निघे ॥ ४९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बायकोची बाजु घेऊन तो आई-बापास दुरुत्तरे करतो. तिरस्काराने बोलुन वेगळा संसार थाटतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then one will take the side of the wife and make a base reply (ie. not this reply of `I am He') to one's own mother and father (mula maya/purush). When he speaks to them in such a way then, he separates himself from them.

owis.original: स्त्रीकारणें लाज सांडिली । स्त्रीकारणें सखीं सोडिलीं । स्त्रीकारणें विघडिलीं । सकळहि जिवलगें ॥ ५० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्त्री साठी लाजलज्जा सोडली. स्त्री साठी जीवाभावाचे मित्र सोडल. सर्व आप्त जीवलग यांच्याशी संबंध बिघडविले.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this woman shame is left aside. Due to this woman, your constant companion is given up. Due to this woman the connection with your most beloved and also this `all' gets broken asunder. (This woman is mula maya and that purush has given his whole life to her and forgotten the independence of his own Self. But then even this woman is forgotten and he becomes a man in samsar and he takes himself a wife. See V. 58)

owis.original: स्त्रीकारणें देह विकिला । स्त्रीकारणें सेवक जाला । स्त्रीकारणें सांडवला । विवेकासी ॥ ५१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्त्री साठी देह विकुन सेवक झाला. स्त्रीसााठी सारासार विवेक विचार सोडला.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this woman, the body is sold off for a price and due to this woman, it becomes a servant. Due to this woman, ones vivek is let slip.

owis.original: स्त्रीकारणें लोलंगता । स्त्रीकारणें अतिनम्रता । स्त्रीकारणें पराधेनता । अंगिकारिली ॥ ५२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्त्री साठी लंपट झाला. अति नम्र होतो. स्त्री साठी पराधीनता स्वीकारली.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this woman, one bows down and rolls over and becomes completely obedient. Due to this woman, one becomes completely subservient. Due to this woman, one accepts this dependence upon another (a body conscious mind).

owis.original: स्त्रीकारणें लोभी जाला । स्त्रीकारणें धर्म सांडिला । स्त्रीकारणें अंतरला । तीर्थयात्रा स्वधर्म ॥ ५३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्त्री साठी लोभी झाला. स्त्री साठी अधार्मिक झाला. तीर्थयात्रा, नित्यकर्म सोडली.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this woman, greed appears. Due to this woman, dharma is left aside. Due to this woman, the pilgrimage of swadharma is discontinued.

owis.original: स्त्रीकारणें सर्वथा कांहीं । शुभाशुभ विचारिलें नाहीं । तनु मनु धनु सर्वहि । अनन्यभावें अर्पिलें ॥ ५४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्त्रीसाठी तन मन धन सर्व तिच्यासाठी वाहुन  टाकले.  शुभाशुभाचा विचार केला नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this woman, this `all' and that thoughtless understanding are not. Therefore, your body, mind and wealth and also this `all' are to be offered with the understanding of no-otherness (thoughtless understanding).

owis.original: स्त्रीकारणें परमार्थ बुडविला । प्राणी स्वहितास नाडला । ईश्र्वरीं कानकोंडा जाला । स्त्रीकारणें कामबुद्धी ॥ ५५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्त्रीसाठी परमार्थ बुडविला. तो स्वतःच्या कल्याणास मुकला. स्त्रीमुळे विषयासक्ती वाढुन ईश्र्वरापुढे जाण्याची लाज वाटु लागली.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this woman, paramarth is drowned and in the prana, one is robbed of one's own benefit. Due to this woman, there is an intellect/buddhi full of lust and it pretends not to hear this prakruti.

owis.original: स्त्रीकारणें सोडिली भक्ती । स्त्रीकारणें सोडिली विरक्ती । स्त्रीकारणें सायोज्य मुक्ती । तेहि तुछ्य मानिली ॥ ५६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्त्री साठी त्याने भक्ती-विरक्तीचा त्याग केला. स्त्री साठी त्याने सायोज्य  मुक्तीसुध्धा कमी लेखीली.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this woman, devotion is given up. Due to this woman, dispassion is let go. Due to this woman, even Final Liberation is felt to be of no worth.

owis.original: येके स्त्रियेचेनि गुणें । ब्रह्मांड मानिलें ठेंगणें । जिवलगें तीं पिसुणें । ऐसीं वाटली ॥ ५७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एका  स्त्री साठी सगळे ब्रह्मांड कमी योग्यतेचे मानिले.  आप्त-स्वकीयांना शत्रु  मानिले.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One takes itself to be these gunas of this woman (when sattwa, raja, tama come together create body consciousness) then, this whole brahmanda/creation is regarded as insignificant and that Supreme feels that His `dearest' is also deceitful (Why has God done this to me?).

owis.original: ऐसी अंतरप्रीति जडली । सर्वस्वाची सांडी केली । तव ते मरोन गेली । अकस्मात भार्या ॥ ५८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशाप्रकारे अंतरबाह्य बायकोवरील प्रेमाने त्याने जवळच्यांनासुद्धा दूर केले. असे असता ाकस्मात ती बायकोच मरुन गेली.
owis.englishMeaning: That One had given his inner most love to this woman but then even this wealth of the `all' was given away and that Reality was beaten and lost and suddenly there is this wife (ie. worldly entanglements).

owis.original: तेणें मनीं शोक वाढला । म्हणे थोर घात जाला । आतां कैंचा बुडाला । संसार माझा॥ ५९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यामुळे शोकाने भरुन गेला. तो म्हणु लागला की माझा फार मोठा घात झाला. माझा संसार बुडाोला.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this, sorrow increased in his mind and that One then says, "The greatest has been destroyed (the greatest is brahman). Why to immerse this `now' (ie. `I am'), in my samsar anymore?" (Due to the sufferings of samsar, vivek has arisen)

owis.original: जिवलगांचा सोडिला संग । अवचिता जाला घरभंग । आतां करुं मायात्याग । म्हणे दुःखें ॥ ६० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जिवलग माणसे सोडली. वेगळे घरसंसार मांडला. अति दुःखाने म्हणु लागला की, आता मायेचा त्याग करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When you give up the company of your most beloved Self then, immediately this broken down house appears (one becomes the body and day by day it slowly gets worn away until one day it will fall down). Due to his suffering he says, "Now, this maya should be given up."

owis.original: स्त्री घेऊन आडवी । उर बडवी पोट बडवी । लाज सांडून गौरवी । लोकां देखतां ॥ ६१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्त्रीचे प्रेत आडवे मांडीवर घेऊन छाती व पोट बडवित लाज सोडून बायकोची स्तुती करु लागला.
owis.englishMeaning: When you accept this woman that crosses your path then, she beats your heart and belly. Leaving aside all shame, that `Master of the senses' (ie. detached purush) goes rummaging through this world of sensory pleasures.

owis.original: म्हणे माझें बुडालें घर । आतां न करी हा संसार । दुःखें आक्रंदला थोर । घोर घोषें ॥ ६२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुःखाने मोठमोठ्याने रडुन म्हणतो की माझे घर बुडाले. आता मी संसार करणार नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: He said, "My home has been destroyed. Now, that thoughtless Self will not make any more samsar." Due to his suffering, that great brahman cried out loudly (this is someti- mes called grave-yard renunciation; caught in the mind, one understands intellectually "I am not this body, I am brahman", but still one refuses to leave the thoughts and become no-mind ie. one is a knowledgeable fool).

owis.original: तेणें जीव वारयावेधला । सर्वस्वाचा उबग आला । तेणें दुःखें जाला । जोगी कां माहात्मा ॥ ६३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वात झालेल्या माणसाप्रमणे तो वेड्यासारखा वागु लागला. अंगाला राख फासुन जोगी बनला.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this, there is a jiva and a mind spinning around like a whirlwind and then any regard for this wealth of the `all' is abandoned. But due to these sufferings, one may also become a Saint. (One may turn away from samsar once and for all, when one understands that these thoughts are keeping me from the joy of my Self)

owis.original: कां तें निघोन जाणें चुकलें । पुन्हां मागुतें लग्न केलें । तेणें अत्यंतचि मग्न जालें । मन द्वितीय संमंधीं ॥ ६४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पण घर सोडले नाही. परत दुसरे लग्न केले. दुसर्‍या बायकोमध्ये मन रमुन गेले.
owis.englishMeaning: But he gave up the idea of renouncing this world and again got *married (to this world). Due to this, the mind became deeply engrossed in another marriage. *(Marriage is a metaphor for the expansion of duality or the diligent engagement in a worldly life)

owis.original: जाला द्वितीय संमंध । सवेंचि मांडिला आनंद । श्रोती व्हावें सावध । पुढिले समासीं ॥ ६५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुसरे लग्न केल्यामुळे त्याच्या आनंदाला भरते आले. पुढील समास ऐकण्यासाठी श्रोत्यानी आता सावध व्हावे.
owis.englishMeaning: There was another marriage and immediately bliss was felt (just like the children playing and the flowing along in bliss and sorrow. See V. 22). The true listener should be alert within this collection of words ahead (and not marry this world). .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Swaguna Pariksha B (An Examination of One’s Own Nature, Part B)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: द्वितीय संमंध जाला । दुःख मागील विसरला । सुख मानून राहिला । संसाराचें ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुसरे लग्न झाले. मग मागचे दुःख विसरतो. परत संसारांत सुख आहे असे मानु लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There was another *marriage and the previous sufferings were forgotten. Still he remained attached to samsar and believed he was happy.11 *(Again forgetting the troubles of before, he threw himself headlong into worldly activity)

owis.original: जाला अत्यंत कृपण । पोटें न खाय अन्न । रुक्याकारणें सांडी प्राण । येकसरा ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो आता फार कंजूष होतो. पोटभर खातपीसुद्धा नाही. पैसा पैसा जमविण्यासाठी सारखा मरमर राबतो.
owis.englishMeaning: But this brought great miserliness and therefore his heart did not taste of this essential `food.'12 He cared so much for money he was prepared to give his life for a few pennies.

owis.original: कदा कल्पांती न वेची । सांचिलेंचि पुन्हा सांची । अंतरी असेल कैंची । सद्वासना ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जग बुडण्याची वेळ आली तरी पैसा खर्च करीत नाही. जमविलेले्या पैशांत अधिकाधिक भर घालू लागल्यावर चांगली वासना कशी येणार?
owis.englishMeaning: That `end of thought' (ie. to taste of the essential `food' called life or beingness by dropping worldly thoughts) was never chosen by him and on the accumulated thoughts he accumulated more thoughts. How then could there be that pure vasana within this inner space (how could everything be forgotten so that there is simply this desire to be)?

owis.original: स्वयें धर्म न करी । धर्मकर्त्यासहि वारी । सर्वकाळ निंदा करी । साधुजनाची ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वतः काही धर्मकृत्य करीत नाही व करणारासही करु नको असे सांगु लागे. नेहमी साधु संतांची निंदा करु लागला.
owis.englishMeaning: He did not make his own natural dharma (to know yourself is your duty); he ruined the good and spontaneous action saying, "I am doing this and I do that" and all the time, he criticised the sadhus and Saints.

owis.original: नेणे तीर्थ नेणे व्रत । नेणे अतित अभ्यागत । मुंगीमुखींचें जें सीत । तेंहि वेंचून सांची ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तीर्थ, व्रत, अतिथी अभ्यागत कोणालाच ओळखी नाहीसा झाला. मुंगीच्या तोंडांतील धान्याचा कणसुद्धा वेचावयास कमी करीना.
owis.englishMeaning: He did not know anything about holy pilgrimages or religious vows. He did not know how to treat the uninvited *guest and even picked up a particle of grain from the mouth of an ant (we have become so miserly; we forget all this belongs to God). *(Knowledge is the uninvited guest)

owis.original: स्वयें पुण्य करवेना । केलें तरी देखवेना । उपहास्य करी मना । नये म्हणौनि ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वतः काही पुण्यकर्म करावयाचे नाही व दुसर्‍याकोणी केलेले पुण्यकर्म बघवत नाही. व तसे करणार्‍याचा दुःस्वास द्वेष करीन करु नको म्हणुन सांगू लागला.
owis.englishMeaning: This most natural action he did not make and even though this natural action was doing, still he did not understand this (siddharameshwar maharaj- you think you do not have knowledge, but knowledge is already with you). And just because the mind does not understand this pure action, still it should not ridicule it (this spontaneous `I am' action is already there; it needs no invitation and on account of it we all say, "I am doing". Therefore nothing more is required to be done; the mind just has to drop its concepts and this action will be revealed).

owis.original: देवां भक्तांस उछेदी । आंगबळें सकळांस खेदी । निष्ठुर शब्दें अंतर भेदी । प्राणीमात्रांचें ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो भक्तांना व देवाला खोटे मानून स्व शक्तीने त्यांना त्रास देऊ लागला. कठोर शब्दाने त्यांना दुखवू लागला.
owis.englishMeaning: He ("I am a body" ego) harassed the devotee of God and tormented this `all' with his physical strength (this `all' is the devotee of God). His cruel words severed this connection to this inner space (and this gentle `word').

owis.original: नीति सांडून मागें । अनीतीनें वर्तो लागे । गर्व धरुन फुगे । सर्वकाळ ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नीतीचा मार्ग सोडून अनीतीने वागु लागला. आणि सदा त्या अभिमानाने वागु लागला.
owis.englishMeaning: The previous justice (vivek) was left aside and the gossip of injustice ("I am a body") was indulged in and so this time of the `all' got puffed up with pride (this `all' action, `He is doing' brought the body ego, "I am doing").

owis.original: पूर्वजांस सिंतरिलें । पक्षश्राद्धहि नाहीं केलें । कुळदैवत ठकिले । कोणेपरी ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पूर्वजांना विसरला. श्राद्ध-पक्ष करीनासा झाला. काहींतरी कारण काढून कुळ-दैवत कुळचार काही पाळीनासा झाला.
owis.englishMeaning: He slandered his ancestory and did not perform the rituals after a death in the family. He made fun of the family deity in whatever way he could (The Self/atma is your elder. maharaj- say they are relatives of this body and not to me then, they are dead or not? We are all born out of knowledge. Thus this `all' is our family god. This he did not understand)

owis.original: आक्षत भरिली भाणा । दुजा ब्राह्मण मेहुणा । आला होता पाहुणा । स्त्रियेस मूळ ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखादे कर्म केलेच तर खर्च वाचविण्यासाठी माहेरी आलेल्या बहिणीला अक्षता देऊन सुवासिण म्हणून व मेहुण्याला  जो त्याच्या बहिणीला माहेरी नेणयास आलेला असतो त्याला ब्राह्मण म्हणून आमंत्रण देऊन खर्च वाचवू लागला.
owis.englishMeaning: As his caste was brahmin his duty included feeding a woman whose husband is alive and so he fed his sister. And he had to feed another brahmin and so he fed his wife's brother. The only guests who came were the in-laws of his wife (but that uninvited guest was never welcomed).

owis.original: कदा नावडे हरिकथा । देव नलगे सर्वथा । स्नानसंध्या म्हणे वृथा । कासया करावी ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हरिकथेचे वावडे व नावद, देवधर्म नकोसा तर स्नान-संध्येची काय जरुरी असे म्हणु लागला.
owis.englishMeaning: He did not like this `story' of hari. He said he did not require God at all. Of the sacred bath and prayers (ie. understanding `I am') he said, "They are a waste of time, why to do?"

owis.original: अभिळाषें सांची वित्त । स्वयें करी विश्र्वासघात । मदें मातला उन्मत्त । तारुण्यपणें ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तरुण वय व जमा केलेला पैसा यामुळे विश्र्वासघातकी बनून उनमत्तपणाने वागु लागला.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this great greed to accumulate riches, that natural *Self becomes deceptive and untrustworthy. And due to this feeling of youthfulness, there is the intoxication for riches and that Self becomes swollen with the pride and arrogance of body consci- ousness. *(Our greatest wealth)

owis.original: तारुण्य आंगी भरलें । धारिष्ट नवचे धरिलें । करुं नये तेंचि केलें । माहा पाप ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तारुण्याच्या भरांत मनावर ताबा  न ठेवता करु नये असे महापाप त्याने केले.
owis.englishMeaning: But it is this `all' body that is overflowing with *youthfulness and placing this youthfulness upon the body, his forbearance could not be maintained and then that Reality did that which it should not do and it committed the `great sin' (ie. to forget one's own Self and take the body as one's self). *(maharaj- I am the youngest here)

owis.original: स्त्री केली परी धाकुटी । धीर न धरवेचि पोटीं । विषयलोभें सेवटीं । वोळखी सांडिली ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्त्री वयांत न आलेली केलेली कामवासनेचा जोर स्वस्थ बसू देईना स्त्री सुख मिळविण्यासाठी कोणाला ओळखिनासा झाला.
owis.englishMeaning: He had his own woman (ie. his own prakruti) but she was too young to touch intimately and he had no forbearance in his heart and so due to his greed for the sense objects he let slip the known/prakruti (the Knower/purush let slip the known and became body conscious).

owis.original: माये बहिण न विचारी । जाला पापी परद्वारी । दंड पावला राजद्वारीं । तर्‍हीं पालटेना ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आई-बहिण कोणाला ऐकीना शेवटी व्यभिचारी झाला. सरकार दरबारी शिक्षा झाली तरी वृत्ती बदलेना.
owis.englishMeaning: That thoughtless purush did not maintain his respect for his virtuous wife and went in sin to the door of another (he opened the door of his restless mind and indulged in `many' desires). And although he was punished in the court of the King, still he did not change his ways and turn within. (The King is the atma and the punishment is lust, jealousy, anger etc. and finally death for the one who says, "I am a body." When this pure prakruti is not kept then, that purush gets enamoured with the body and seeks sensual pleasures)13

owis.original: परस्त्री देखोन दृष्टीं । अभिळाष उठे पोटीं । अकर्तव्यें हिंपुटी । पुन्हां होये ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: परस्त्रीला बघुन वाईट वासनेने तीची इच्छा करी. पण ती मिळण्याची आशा नसल्याने हिरमुसला होऊन दुःखी होई.
owis.englishMeaning: When the other woman within this `all'/prakruti, appeared before his eyes, great desire arose in his mind. By doing that which is not one's duty (ie. to know thyself), one tumbles downward into this gross form again and again (maharaj- you see a woman and the Master sees brahman).

owis.original: ऐसें पाप उदंड केलें । शुभाशुभ नाहीं उरलें । तेणें दोषें दुःख भरलें । अकस्मात आंगी ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असे त्याने फार पाप केले. शुभ अशुभ कसलाच विचार केला नाही. त्यामुळे दुःख व त्याचे योगे व्यसने वगैरे दोषाने त्याला धरले.
owis.englishMeaning: Such was the sin committed by that vast paramatma and so vivek could not remain. Then that purush, within this prakruti, was covered over with the pains and sorrows caused by believing "I am a gross body."

owis.original: व्याधी भरली सर्वांगीं । प्राणी जाला क्षयरोगी । केले दोष आपुले भोगी । सीघ्र काळें ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्वांग रोगांनी भरले. क्षयरोगी झाला. आपल्याच पापाचे भोग लवकरच भोगण्याची वेळ आली.
owis.englishMeaning: This `I am' body was filled with the disease "I am a gross body" and in the prana there appeared this wasting, decaying sickness. And having sinned, he has to endure *`Saturn's return'. *(siddharameshwar maharaj- inauspicious time of body con- sciousness)15

owis.original: दुःखें सर्वांग फुटलें । नासिक अवघेंचि बैसलें । लक्षण जाऊन जालें । कुलक्षण ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रोगाने सर्व शरीर फुटले, सर्वांगावर फोड उठले. नाक झडले. चांगले स्वरुप जाऊन कुलक्षणी बेढब दिसू लागला.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to such suffering, this body of the `all' was broken and divided; due to the `many' thoughts, atheism had established itself; this pure attention was destroyed and there appeared the false attentions of the restless mind.

owis.original: देहास क्षीणता आली । नाना वेथा उद्भवली । तारुण्यशक्ती राहिली । खंगला प्राणी ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह अशक्त झाला. निरनिराळ्या व्यथांनी तारुण्याचा जोर ओसरल व त्याचा देह खंगु लागल.
owis.englishMeaning: The gross body began wasting away and there arose the `many' pains. His youthful energy (`I am everywhere') was gone and in the prana there was this feeble body.

owis.original: सर्वांगी लागल्या कळा । देहास आली अवकळा । प्राणी कांपे चळचळां । शक्ति नाहीं ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याच्या सर्वांगाला कळा लागल्या. देह कळाहीन झाला. शक्तीहीन झाल्याने देहाला कंप भरला.
owis.englishMeaning: By remaining in this `I am' body, there is this connection to that unique art of knowing but, this had been lost and there came the troubles and distress of the gross body. When in the prana there came this trembling caused by acute fear then, how could there be this power of the `all'? (If one takes oneself to be a gross body then, this brings fears, desires etc. and this `all' is drowned in `many' thoughts)

owis.original: हस्तपादादिक झडले । सर्वांगी किडे पडिले । देखोन थुंको लागले । लाहानथोर ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हातपाय झडले. सर्वांगी किडे पडले. लहानमोठे त्याला बघुन थुंकु लागले.
owis.englishMeaning: His hands and legs and his whole body trembled and within this `all' body there appeared this sinful and loathsome gross consciousness. And before its very own eyes, that *`great in the small' began to spit (that great and vast brahman forgets its Self 15siddarameshwar maharaj- sadesati means seven and a half.
