Therefore faith and determination are required to first establish this knowledge and then to throw off this knowledge. maharaj- some climb up step by step, but the one who understands, goes straight to the top and jumps off. .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: तापत्रांचे लक्षण । आतां सांगिजेल निरुपण । श्रोतीं करावें श्रवण । येकाग्र होऊनी ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह, इंद्रियें आणि प्राण यंच्यामुळे जे सुख-दुःख प्राप्त होते, भोगावें लागते त्यास आध्यात्मिक ताप असे म्हणतात. यामुळे दुःखच भोगावे लागते.
owis.englishMeaning: The attention of these three gunas bring the three torments. But now (with this sagun `experience'), that nirgun discourse should be told. Therefore, in the listener there should be single-pointed listening (and then the attention that brings these three torments will be wiped out).

owis.original: सर्वभूतेन संयोगात् सुखं दुःखं च जायते । द्वितीयतापसंतापः सत्यं चैवाधिभौतिकः ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व भूतांच्या (प्राण्यांच्या) संबंधामुळे जे सुख-दुःख भोगावे लागते त्याला आधिभौतिक ताप असे म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma purush who has been scorched by the three torments, gets peace in the company of the Truth/Saint. That One who hankers with deep painful longing, becomes joyful when He enjoys this `all' of his longing.

owis.original: शुभाशुभेन कर्मणा देहांते यमयातना । स्वर्गनरकादि भोक्तव्यमिदं चैवाधिदैविकम् ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मनुष्याला त्याने केलेल्या शुभ वा अशुभ कर्मांमुळे स्वर्ग वा नरकामध्ये जे सुख-दुःख भोगावे लागते त्यास आधिदैविक ताप असे म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that one who was oppressed by hunger, receives this `food', `I am'; when that one who was oppressed by thirst, receives this `living water'; when that one who was imprisoned gets released then, there is the overflowing of joy.

owis.original: माहापुरें जाजावला । तो पैलतीरास नेला । कां तो स्वप्नींचा चेइला । स्वप्न दुःखी ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जसे महापुरांत सापडलेल्याला पैलतीरास नेले किंवा वाईट स्वप्नाने दुःखी झालेल्यास जागे केल्यावर जसे सुख लाभते.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that atma that had been swept away by this great flood of maya reached the other side; then that atma who had been suffering in a dream, awoke from the dream.

owis.original: कोणी येकासी मरण । येतां दिलें जीवदान । संकटास निवारण । तोडितां सुख ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: किंवा एखाद्यास मरण येत असता जीवदान दिले किंवा संकटांत सापडलेल्याचे संकट निवारण केल्यावर त्याला जसे सुख मिळते,
owis.englishMeaning: That One who is within everyone was dying and He was given the gift of life. That One who was in great peril got saved and there was the overflowing of happiness.

owis.original: रोगीयास औषध । सप्रचित आणि शुद्ध । तयासी होये आनंद । आरोग्य होतां ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रोग्याला योग्य औषध दिल्यावर तब्बेत सुधारल्यामुळे जसा आनंद होतो,
owis.englishMeaning: When that One who had been diseased was given this medicine of `I am' then, that atma became blissful and was freed from this disease of "I am a body".

owis.original: तैसा संसारें दुःखवला । त्रिविधतापें पोळला । तोचि एक अधिकारी जाला । परमार्थासी ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तसा संसार दुःखाने दुःखी झालेल्याला व त्रिविध तापाने पोळलेला माणूस परमार्थाच्या शाश्र्वत सुखास पात्र होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When you have suffered in samsar and have been burnt by the three forms of torment, then only do you become a worthy recipient of paramarth.

owis.original: ते त्रिविध ताप ते कैसे । आतां बोलिजेत तैसे । येविषंई येक असे । वाक्याधार ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हे त्रिविध ताप कसे, ते मी आतां सांगतो. त्याच्यांबद्दल एका वाक्यांचा संदर्भ आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: But if that Reality becomes these three torments then, how can there be that Reality? Now, there should be this `speech' and on account of this, there should be that One purush, the supporter of this `speech'. (Forget everything and remain in that which remains. This is knowledge or this `speech'. Then understand that even this knowledge is not required)

owis.original: येक ताप आध्यात्मिक । दूजा तो आधिभूतिक । तिसरा आधिदैविक । ताप जाणावा ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एक ताप आध्यात्मिक, दुसरा आधिभूतिक आणि तिसरा आधिदैविक ताप समजावा.
owis.englishMeaning: One torment is mental; the second torment relates to the elemental or physical world and the third torment relates to the gods or deities (ie. destiny; the result of past actions). You should know these torments.

owis.original: आध्यात्मिक तो कोण । कैसी त्याची वोळखण । आदिभूतिकाचें लक्षण । जाणिजे कैसें ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आध्यात्मिक ताप कसा व तो कसा ओळखावा; आधिभूतिक ताप कसा ओळखावा त्यांची लक्षणें समजून घ्या.
owis.englishMeaning: How can that atma be mentally tormented and what is the recognition of that atma? And why should these elemental or physical torments be known by that atma? (Understand this torment happens to the body and not to that atma)

owis.original: आदिदैविक तो कैसा । कवण तयाची दशा । हेंहि विशद कळे ऐसा । विस्तार कीजे ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आधिदैविक कसा व त्याने काय अवस्था ओढवते; ते सविस्तर विस्तार करुन सांगा.
owis.englishMeaning: And how can that atma have the torments of destiny/the gods? How can that Reality be a state or difficult condition? That thoughtless swarup should be clearly understood and made to expand.

owis.original: हां जी म्हणोनि वक्ता । जाला कथा विस्तारिता । आध्यात्मिक ताप आतां । सावध ऐका ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हो तसेच करतो. म्हणून वक्ता म्हणजेच श्रीसमर्थ रामदास सविस्तर आध्यात्मिक ताप कसा तो समजुन घ्या असे म्हणाले.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore that thoughtless `speaker' has to expand this `story' of God and when there are these mental torments then, listen alertly now (and by listening to this `I am', the torments will be transcended).

owis.original: देह इंद्रिय आणी प्राण । यांचेनि योगें आपण । सुखदुःखें सिणे जाण । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह, इंद्रिय आणी प्राण यांच्या योगे आपण सुखी किंवा दुःखी होतो. त्या तापाला आध्यात्मिक ताप म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When this `speech' of `I am' has union with the body, the organs of the senses, the organs of action and the prana, then the weariness of pleasure and pain is known and to this `I am' there comes mental torment (then this `I am' is forgotten and body, senses etc. appear and then mental torment is accepted)

owis.original: देहामधून जें आलें । इंद्रियें प्राणें दुःख जाले । तें आध्यात्मिक बोलिलें । तापत्रईं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जे दुःख देहामुळे निर्माण होते आणि इंद्रिये व प्राण यांच्याद्वारे भोगावे लागते त्या तापाला  तीन तापापैकी आध्यात्मिक ताप असे म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When mula maya (`I am') comes into a body then, due to the organs of sense and the organs of action and the prana, suffering appears. Then to that Reality and this `speech' there comes these mental torments.

owis.original: देहामधून काये आलें । प्राणें कोण दुःख जालें । आतां हें विशद केलें । पाहिजे कीं ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देहामधुन कोठचे दुःख निर्माण होते व जे प्राणामुळे कोणते दुःख होते.. ते आता सांगितले पाहिजे.
owis.englishMeaning: If in the body some mental torment has come and if due to the prana, some pain appears then, how now can that thoughtless pure knowledge be created? (And when there is that thoughtless knowledge then, how can mental torment be created?)

owis.original: खरुज खवडे पुळिया नारु । नखरुडें मांजर्‍या देवि गोवरु । देहामधील विकारु । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खरुज, खवडे, अंगावरील पुळ्या, नखुरडें, मांजर्‍या, देवि, गोवर हे देहामधून येणारे विकार आहेत. त्यांना आध्यात्मिक ताप समजतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is scabies; when the scalp is diseased; when there are pustules, guinea worms, swelling at the hair-root, or smallpox or measles; when there are such disorders within the body then, to this `I am' there has come mental torment.

owis.original: काखमांजरी केशतोड । वोखटें वर्ण काळफोड । व्याधी मूळव्याधी माहाजड । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तसेंच काखमांजरी, केस्तुड, सडणारा काळा व्रण, काळपुळी, अति दुःखदायक मूळव्याध हे आध्यात्मिक ताप आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is a septic tumour in the armpit, a boil at the root of the hair, bad skin, a sore and other very painful ailments like piles; then to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: अंगुळवेडे गालफुगी । कंड लागे जे वाउगी । हिरडी सुजे भरे बलंगी । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बोटांचे दुखणें, गालफुगी, उगीचच अंगावर उठणारी खाज, हिरडी सुजणे याना आध्यात्मिक ताप समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When among other physical troubles there are swollen fingers; when this mula maya is mumps, irritations and scratching, swelling of gums and broken teeth; then to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: वाउगे फोड उठती । कां ते सुजे आंगकांती । वात आणी तिडका लागती । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंगावर फोड उठणें, अंगावर सूज येणे, वात होणे, तिडका लागणें, यांना आध्यात्मिक ताप समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are blisters or that Reality is the swelling of the body, or when there is flatulence and cramps then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: नाईटे अंदु गजकर्ण । पेहाचें पोट विस्तीर्ण । बैसलें टाळें फुटती कर्ण । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नायटे, हाड्याव्रण, गजकर्ण, जलोदर, यांना आध्यात्मिक ताप समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is a deep-rooted ulcer or the spread of ringworm; when there is palsy or an ear infection then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: कुष्ट आणी वोला कुट । पंड्यारोग अतिश्रेष्ठ । क्षयरोगचे कष्ट । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पांढरे कोड, महारोग, रोगांतील मोठा पंडुरोग, रक्तक्षय, क्षयरोग यांना आध्यात्मिक ताप समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is dry and wet leprosy, anemia or tuberculosis and other major diseases of the body then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: वाटी वटक वायेगोळा । हातीं पांई लागती कळा । भोवंडी लागे वेळोवेळां । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गांठ सरकणे, वांति, हातापायां येणार्‍या कळा, वेळोवेळी येणारी चक्कर, यांना आध्यात्मिक ताप समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is an inflammation of the joints or the food does not get properly digested; when gas is created in the bowel or there is continuous pain in the arms and legs or recurrent giddiness; then to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: वोलांडा आणी वळ । पोटसुळाची तळमळ । आर्धशिसी उठे कपाळ । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वोलांडा, वळ, पोटशूळाच्या वेदना, अर्धशिशी, कपाळदुखी यांना आध्यात्मिक ताप समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is a urine infection, spots on the skin, stomach ache and migraine headaches; then to this `I am' `name' there has come mental torment.

owis.original: दुःखे माज आणी मान । पुष्ठी ग्रीवा आणी वदन । अस्तिसांदे दुःखती जाण । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कंबर, मान, पाठ, गळा, तोंड दुखणें, हाडांचे सांधे दुखणें यांना आध्यात्मिक ताप समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is a pain in the groin or a pain in the neck, back-pain or month pain or joint pains; then to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: कुळिक तरळ कामिणी । मुरमा सुंठरें माळिणी । विदेसीं लागलें पाणी । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मोडशी, अजीर्णामुळे होणार्‍या ओकार्‍या, हागवण विदेशी पाणी बाधणे, यांना आध्यात्मिक ताप समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is colic pain, diarrhoea and vomiting, or jaundice, skin disorders, boils in the nose and fever caused by the change of water and climate; then to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: जळसोस आणी हिवारें । गिरीविरी आणि अंधारें । ज्वर पाचाव आणी शारें । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोरड पडणें, हिंवताप, गरगरणें, अंधारी येणे, ताप, दुखणे उलटणे, अंगावर शहारे येणे यांना आध्यात्मिक ताप समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is dehydration or flu; or vertigo or darkness before the eyes, when there is a relapsing fever and shivering; then to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: शैत्य उष्ण आणी तृषा । क्षुधा निद्रा आणी दिशा । विषयतृष्णेची दुर्दशा । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: थंडी, उकाडा, तहान, भूक, झोंप, हगवण, अति संभोगामुळे होणारी वाईट अवस्था यांना आध्यात्मिक ताप समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is acute cold and heat; when there is hunger, drowsiness and bewil- derment; or when there is the distressful condition caused by the longing for sexual passion; then to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: आळसी मूर्ख आणी अपेसी । भय उद्भवें मानसीं । विसराळु दुश्र्चित आहिर्निशी । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आळशी, मूर्ख, अपेशी, मनांत भय येणे, विसराळूपणा, नेहमी उद्विग्न रहाणे यांना आध्यात्मिक ताप समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is laziness, foolishness and dishonour. When fear manifests in the mind; when there is forgetfulness and duschit (see 8.6; to forget Self.) each and every moment; then to this sagun `name' has come mental torment.

owis.original: मूत्रकोड आणी परमें । रक्तपिती रक्तपरमें । खडाचढाचेनि श्रमे । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लघवी अडणें, परमा, रक्तपिती, रक्तीपरमा, मूतखडा व त्याच्या वेदना यांना आध्यात्मिक ताप समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is incontinence or gonorrhoea or bleeding ulcers; when the stools are hard like pebbles then one is very uneasy and to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: मुरडा हागवण उन्हाळे । दिशा कोंडतां आंदोळे । येक वेथा असोन न कळे । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मुरडा, हगवण, उन्हाळा लागणें, शौच कोंडल्यामुळे होणारी तगमग, रोगाचे निदान न होणे यांना आध्यात्मिक ताप समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is an excruciating pain in the abdomen, diarrhoea or a stomach in- fection; when there is the agitation caused by constipation or when there is the wrong diagnosis of a disease then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: गांठी ढळली जाले जंत । पडे आव आणी रक्त । आन्न तैसेंचि पडत । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गांठ सरकणे, जंत होणे, आव व रक्ती आव होणे, अन्न न पचता तसेच पडणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there is a hernia or worms or dysentery; when the stools contain undigested food and blood then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: पोटफुगी आणी तडस । भरला हिर लागला घांस । फोडी लागतां कासावीस । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पोट फुगणे, तडस लागणे, ठसका लागणे, घांस अडकणे, फोडाला धक्का लागून जीव घाबरा होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there is a swelling of the stomach and sharp pains; when there is a sprain or it is difficult to swallow; or when there is the discomfort of small boils then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: उचकी लागली उसित गेला । पीत उसळलें उलाटा जाला । खरे पडस आणि खोकला । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उचकी लागणे, घांस अडकणे. लागणे, पित्त उसळणे, वांती होणे, जीभकांटे येणे, पडसें, खोकला होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there are hiccoughs or a feeling of choking; when there is bile and vomiting; when the tongue is dried and there is a cold and cough then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: उसळला दमा आणी धाप । पडजिभ ढासि आणी कफ । मावाज्वर आणी संताप । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दमा उसळणे, धाप लागणे, पडजिभेची ढास, कफ होणे, मोवाज्वर येणें, अंगाची आग होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there is asthma, breathlessness or the infection of the throat; when there is heavy coughing or a wet cough or a fit caused by a fever; when there is meningitis or a high temperature then to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: कोणी सेंदुर घातला । तेणें प्राणी निर्बुजला । घशामध्यें फोड जाला । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी सेंदूर खायला घातल्याने मनावर परिणाम होणे, घशामध्ये फोड होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When someone has been shamed or disgraced; when in the prana, that Reality has fear and bewilderment; or when the voice begins to divulge that which cannot be divulged then, to this `I am' `name' has come mental torment (this `name' cannot be divulged; it is the original `speech' and beyond the thoughts and talk of the mind).

owis.original: गळसोट्या आणी जीभ झडे । सदामुखीं दुर्गंधी पडे । दंतहीन लागती किडे । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: घटसर्प होणे, जीभ झडणे, नेहमी तोंडाला दुर्गंधी येणे, दांत पडून हिरड्यांवर कृमी होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there is diphtheria or a pain in the tongue; when the breath is foul or the teeth fall out due to a gum infection then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: जरंडी घोलाणा गंडमाळा । अवचिता स्वयें फुटे डोळा । आपणचि कापी अंगुळा । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पांथरी वाढणे, घोळण फुटणे, गंडमाळा, अचानक डोळा फुटणे, आपणच आपले बोट कापून घेणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there is a spleen disorder or nose bleeds; when there is scrofula or a sudden accident involving the loss of an eye; when the finger gets accidentally cut then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: कळा तिडका लागती । कां ते दंत उन्मळती । अधर जिव्हा रगडती । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कळा व तिडका लागणे, दांत उपटले जाणे, ओठ व जिभ चावली जाणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there is some pain or a tooth is pulled out; when the lips or the tongue is bitten then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: कर्णदुःख नेत्रदुःख । नानादुःखें घडे शोक । गर्भांध आणी नपुश्यक । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कान ठणकणे, डोळे दुखणे, नाना प्रकारच्या दुःखाने ओरडणे, जन्मांध असणे, नपुंसक असणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there is a pain in the ear or a pain in the eye; when one suffers due to the `many' pains; when one has congenital blindness or one is born a eunuch then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: फुलें वडस आणी पडळें । कीड गर्ता रातांधळें । दुश्र्चित्त भ्रमिष्ट आणी खुळें । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: डोळ्यांत फुल पडणे, वडस वाढणे, मोतीबिंदु व कांच बिंदु होणे, डोळ्यांच्या पापण्यांना कीड लागणे, डोळे असून न दिसणे, रातांधळेपणा असणे, दुश्चितपण, भ्रमिष्टपणा आणि खुळेपणा असणे  यांना आध्यात्मिक ताप समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are white stops on the eyes or there is the formation of a cataract over the pupil; when the eye is diseased or there is night blindness; when one is confused, depressed or mentally challenged then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: मुकें बधीर राखोंडें । थोटें चळलें आणी वेडें । पांगुळ कुर्‍हें आणी पावडें । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मुकेपण, बहिरेपणा, ओठ तुटके, हात तुटके, वृत्ति चळलेला असणे, वेडेपणा, पांगळेपणा, कुबड, आंखुड पाय,
owis.englishMeaning: When one is mute, deaf or lame; when one is deprived of a limb or mentally unstable; when one is paralysed or has a malformed spine or when one leg is shorter than the other then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: तारसें घुलें काणें कैरें । गारोळें जामुन टाफरें । शडांगुळें गेंगाणें विदरें । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तारवटलेले डोळे, वांकडी मान, काणा, तिरळा, घारे डोळे, अति ठेंगुपणा, ठेचळणे, सहा बोटे, गेंगाणा, विद्रुप,
owis.englishMeaning: When one has a lazy eye, a twisted neck or a squint; when one has staring bulbous eyes or discoloured eyes; when one's growth is stunted, or one can't walk properly; when one has six fingers or a nasal speech or one is ugly then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: दांतिरें बोचिरें घानाळ । घ्राणहीन श्रोत्रहीन बरळ । अति कृश अति स्थूळ । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मोठे दांत, पुढे आलेले दांत, फार लांब नाक, नाक नसलेला, कान नसणें, बरळणारा, अशक्त, अति बारीक, अति जाडा,
owis.englishMeaning: When one has protruding teeth or the front teeth are missing or one has a large nose; when one has no nose, or no ears and when one babbles meaninglessly; when one is very thin or very fat then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: तोंतरें बोंबडें निर्बळ । रोगी कुरुप कुटीळ । मत्सरी खादाड तपीळ । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ४४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तोतरा, बोबडा, अशक्त, रोगी, कुरुप, वाकड्या बुद्धीचा, मत्सरी, खादाड, तापट,
owis.englishMeaning: If one has a stammer or can't talk properly; if one is weak, diseased or has an unattractive face or body; if one is jealous, gluttonous or short-tempered then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: संतापी अनुताप मत्सरी । कामिक हेवा तिरस्कारी । पापी अवगुणी विकारी । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ४५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: संतापी, अनुतापी, मत्सरी, कामुक, हेवेदावे करणारा, तिरस्कारी, पापी, अवगुणी, विकाराधीन,
owis.englishMeaning: If one is bad tempered, vengeful and malicious; if one is lustful, envious and insulting; if one is wicked and vicious then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: उठवणें ताठा करक । आवटळे आणी लचक । सुजी आणी चालक । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ४६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याला नीट उठता बसता येत नाही, अंग ताठणें, अवघडणें, लचक भरणे, सूज येणे, पायांचा संधिवात,
owis.englishMeaning: If one has difficulty in getting up or has stiffness or lumbago; if one has a stiff neck, a pulled muscle or a swollen and painful leg then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: सल आडवें गर्भपात । स्तनगुंते सनपात । संसारकोंडें आपमृत्य । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ४७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: न वाढणारा गर्भ, मूल आडवे येणे, गर्भपात, स्तनांतील गांठी सन्निपाात, संसारांतील अडचणी, अपमृत्यु,
owis.englishMeaning: If one has a premature birth, a miscarriage or a difficult delivery; if in the breasts the milk is not created or it gets infected; if there are family troubles or an untimely death then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: नखविख आणी हिंगुर्डे । बाष्ट आणी वावडें । उगीच दांतखीळ पडे । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ४८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नखाचें वीष बाधणे, नखुर्डे, शिळे व कुपथ्याचे खाणे त्यामुळे प्रकृती बिघडणे, उगीचच दांतखीळ बसणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If there is an infected nail or one's strength wastes away; if one has stomach upset due to too much food or wrong food; if that `still and silent' gets lockjaw then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: झडती पातीं सुजती भुवया । नेत्रीं होती राझणवडीया । चाळसी लागे प्राणियां । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ४९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: डोळ्याच्या पापण्या झडणे, भुवया सुजणे, डोळ्यांना रांजणवाडी होणे, चाळीसी लागणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When the eyelid is swollen or the eyebrows are knitted together; when there is conjunctivitis or the necessity to wear spectacles then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: वांग तिळ सुरमें लासें । चामखिळ गलंडें मसें । चुकुर होईजे मानसें । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ५० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंगावर काळ्या पुळ्या येणे, तीळ, पांढरे चट्टे, काळे चट्टे, चामखीळ, गालगुंड, अंगावर मांस वाढणे, मनाला भ्रम होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there are liver marks or moles on the skin or the skin loses its pigmentation; when there is a boil or ulcer on the skin; when dementia comes to the mind then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: नाना फुग आणी आवाळें । आंगीं दुर्गंधी प्रबळे । चाईचाटी लाळ गळे । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ५१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अगावर येणारे फुगवटे, आवाळे, अंगाला फार दुर्गंधी येणे, डोक्यारचे केस गळणे,  तोंडांतुन लाळ गळणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the arising and swelling of the `many' thoughts and the appearance of this large fleshy growth called the body; when in this `all' body there arises a foul smell; when there is rowdy behaviour and meaningless chatter and shallow affections and longings; then to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: नाना चिंतेची काजळी । नाना दुःखें चित्त पोळी । व्याधीवांचून तळमळी । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ५२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नाना काळज्यांनी काळवंडणे, नाना दुःखांनी मनाला यातना होणे, कांही होत नसतां जीव घाबरा होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the `many' anguishes and worries; when there are the `many' burning pains of thinking; when anxiety exists even if there are no ailments; then mental torment has come to this `I am'.

owis.original: वृद्धपणीच्या आपदा । नाना रोग होती सदा । देह क्षीण सर्वदा । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ५३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हातारपणांतील यातना, नेहमी काहींतरी रोग होणे, नेहमी देह अशक्त असणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the trouble of old age and the `many' diseases are present; when the body begins to waste away then, to this `I am' there comes mental torment.

owis.original: नाना व्याधी नाना दुःखें । नाना भोग नाना खांडकें । प्राणी तळमळी शोकें । या नाव आध्यात्मिक ॥ ५४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुष्कळ रोग, पुष्कळ दुःखे, अनेक भोग, अनेक जखमा यामुळे दुःखाने नेहमी तळमळ होणे, यांना आध्यात्मिक ताप समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the `many' illnesses and the `many' sufferings; when there are the `many' experiences and the `many' broken parts (and one the unbroken One); when in the prana there are sorrows and anxieties then, to this `I am' has come mental torment.

owis.original: ऐसा आध्यात्मिक ताप । पूर्व पापाचा संताप । सांगतां सरेना अमूप । दुःखसागर ॥ ५५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा आध्यात्मिक ताप असा आहे. पूर्वी केलेल्या पापांनी हा ताप होतो. कितीही सांगितले तरी हा संपणारा नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: Like this is mental torment. It is the passions and agonies of the previous sin of taking oneself as a body. But that one who does not exist will not be drowned in this immeasurable ocean of suffering.

owis.original: बहुत काय बोलावें । श्रोतीं संकेतें जाणावें । पुढें बोलिजे स्वभावें । आदिभूतिक ॥ ५६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जास्त काय सांगू श्रोत्यांनी मी सांगितलेल्या संकेत खुणांनी समजुन घ्वावे. पुढिल समासी आदिभूतिक ताप सांगणार आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: What more should this `all' speak but `I am'! In the listener, this `all' should be understood and then afterwards, the elemental or physical torments will be this spontaneous `all' (when everything is forgotten then these sensations of pleasure and pain are regarded with equanimity and one understands, `They appear upon me, but they are not mine'). .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Aadhibhutik Tap Nirupan (Torments of the Elemental World)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: मागां जालें निरुपण । आध्यात्मिकाचें लक्षण । आतां आदिभूतिक तो कोण । सांगिजेल ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व सजिवांच्या संयोगामुळे सुख-दुःख निर्माण होते ते जीवाला भोगावे लागते. हा दुसरा ताप म्हणजे आदिभौतिक ताप होय.
owis.englishMeaning: Previously there was this `I am' discourse and then there came that attention that brings the mental torments (ie. attention of body consciousness). Now, when one forgets everything, these physical or elemental torments will be this `I am' and then that atma should be understood (I do not exist).

owis.original: सर्व भूतांचेनि संयोगें । सुख दुःख उपजों लागे । ताप होतां मन भंगे । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व भूतांशी संबंध आल्याने सुख किंवा दुःख निर्माण होते. यामुळे जीवाच्या मनावर परिणाम होतो. या तापास आदिभूतिक ताप म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If this `I am' has contact with the great elements (ie. objectification) then, there arises the torments of pleasure and pain; then the mind is disturbed and to this `I am' there comes the torments of this physical world.

owis.original: तरी या आदिभूतिकाचें लक्षण । प्रांजळ करुं निरुपण । जेणें अनुभवास ये पूर्ण । वोळखी तापत्रयाची ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या आदिभूतिक तापाची लक्षणे सांगतो ज्यामुळे हा दुसरा ताप ओळखता येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: When this `I am' experience has the attention that brings these worldly torments then, this `I am' discourse should be clearly `spoken'. Then these three torments that have come to this `experience' can be fully understood. (These torments come to the mind and body but this `I am experience' is not affected)

owis.original: ठेंचा लागती मोडती कांटे । विझती शस्त्रांचे धायटे । सला सिलका आणी सरांटे । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ठेंचा लागणे, काटे मोडणे, हत्यारांचे घाव लागणे, बारीक कुसे शरीरांत घुसणे, सराटे लागणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there is an injury to the foot or a thorn breaks and sticks within your flesh; when a needle or sliver of bamboo pierces the skin then, to this `I am' has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: अंग्या आणी काचकुहिरी । आवचटा लागे शरीरीं । गांधील येऊन दंश करी । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंगास आग आणणारी, तसेच खाज आणणारी वनस्पती लागणे, गांधील माशीनें येऊन दंश करणे,
owis.englishMeaning: Then there are allergies and stings from various plants and the bites and stings of various insects then, to this `I am' comes the torments of this physical world.

owis.original: मासी गोमासी मोहळमासी । मुंगी तेलमुंगी डांस दसी । सोट जळु लागे यासी । आदिभूतिक बोलिजे ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माशी, गोमाशी, मोहळमाशी, मुंगी, तेलमुंगी, डांस यांनी डसणे, सोट म्हणजे रक्त पिणारा किडा, जळु अंगास चिकटणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there are flies, wasps and bees; when there are various kinds of ants, stinging flies and mosquitoes; when there are leeches or biting insects then, to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: पिसा पिसोळे चांचण । कुसळें मुंगळे ढेंकुण । विसीफ भोवर गोंचिड जाण । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ७॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पिसवा, पिसोळे,चांचण म्हणजे तांबडे मुंगळे, कुसळे, मुंगळे, ढेंकुण, इसबाचे किडे, भुंगे, गोचिडे,
owis.englishMeaning: When fleas and other small creatures bite; when large red ants and the bristles of grains irritate; when mites, bugs and cattle louse bite then, to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: गोंबी विंचु आणी विखार । व्याघ्र लांडिगे आणी शूकर । गौसायळ सामर । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गोम, विंचू, साप, वाघ, लांडगे, डुक्कर, साळू, सांबर,
owis.englishMeaning: When centipedes and scorpion's sting; when a tiger or a wolf or a boar attacks a man; when birds bite or a beast of burden bites then, to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: रानगाई रानम्हैसे । रानशकट्ट आणी रीसें । रानहाती लावपिसें । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रानगाई, रानम्हशी, रानबैल, अस्वलें, रानहत्ती, पक्ष्यांची पिसें,
owis.englishMeaning: When wild cows, bison, bears, elephants or other wild animals attack; when wild birds attack; then to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: सुसरीनें वोढून नेलें । कां तें आवचितें बुडालें । आथवा खळाळीं पडिलें । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मगरीने ओढून नेणे, एकाएकी पाण्यांत बुडणे, किंवा पाय घसरुन पाण्याच्या प्रवाहांत पडणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If the crocodile (ie. ego see 3.10.3) drags one away or that Reality is suddenly drowned; or if that Reality falls down into agitation; then to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: नाना विखारें आजगर । नाना मगरें जळचर । नाना वनचरें अपार । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विषारी सर्प, मगर, अजगर, इतर जळचर, अनेक जंगली जनावरें, यांच्यामुळे जे दुःख होते ते आदिभूतिक समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: If there are `many' large and small snakes; if there are `many' reptiles and creatures of the water; and if that limitless paramatma becomes these `many' wild animals then, to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: अश्र्व वृषभ आणी खर । स्वान शूकर जंबुक मार्जार । ऐसीं बहुविध क्रूर । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: घोडा, बैल, गाढव, कुत्रे, डुक्कर, कोल्हे, मांजर या क्रूर प्ारण्यांपासून दुःख होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When a man is attacked by a horse, a bull, a donkey, a dog, a pig, a fox or vicious cat; then to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: ऐसीं कर्कशें भयानकें । बहुविध दुःखदायकें । दुःखें दारुणें अनेकें । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशी कर्कश, भयंकर नाना रीतीने यातना देणारी अनेक असह्य दुःखे,
owis.englishMeaning: One may be viciously attacked, for the ways of the `many' are the givers of much pain; when due to the many different gross forms there is agitation and suffering then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: भिंती माळवदें पडती । कडे भुयेरीं कोंसळती । वृक्ष आणगावरी मोडती । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भिंती व माळवदे किंवा गच्चीअंगावर कोसळणे, कडे, भुयारे, कोसळणे, झाडे अंगावर पडून अवयव मोडणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If a wall or slab collapses; if a cliff or tunnel suddenly falls upon one; or if this gross body falls upon this `all' body; then to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: कोणी येकाचा श्राप जडे । कोणी येकें केले चेडे । आधांतरी होती वेडे । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणाचा शाप लागणे, कोणाचा जादूटोणा लागणे, उगाचच वेडे होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If that *One within everyone gets cursed (ie. "You are a body; your name is so and so"); if that One within everyone starts making sorcery (ie. "This is a man and that is a women" etc., when that One starts imagining `many' forms) and becomes mad after these objects of the world that are made out of nothing; then to this `I am' `name' there comes the torments of this world. *(That atma purush within every creature)

owis.original: कोणी येकें चाळविलें । कोणी येकें भ्रष्टविलें । कोणी येकें धरुन नेलें । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणेतरी फसविणे, कोणीतरी भ्रष्ट करणे, कोणीतरी धरुन नेणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If that One within everyone gets provoked and beguiled; if that One within everyone gets polluted and defiled; if that One within everyone is seized and taken away; then to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: कोणी येकें दिलें वीष । कोणी येकें लाविले दोष । कोणी येकें घातले पाश । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी वीष देणे, कोणीतरी खोटा आळ घेणे, कोणीतरी पाश घालणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If that One within everyone is given poison (these objects of the world are a poison, for our desire for them brings a slow death); if that One within everyone is blamed and accused; if that One within everyone is ensnared and trapped; then to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: अवचिता सेर लागला । नेणो बिबवा चिडला । प्राणी धुरें जाजावला । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कल्पना नसतां शेराच्या झाडाचा चीक लागणे, बिब्बा उतणे, धुराने जीव घाबरा होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If suddenly one meets a lion, a tiger or an overpowering man; if due to ignorance some obstruction appears before you; if in the prana, this great burden is thrown upon you; then to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: इंगळावरी पाय पडे । शिळेखालें हात सांपडे । धावतां आडखुळे पडे । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विंचवावर पाय पडणे, दगडाखाली हात सापडणे, धावताधावता अडखळून पडणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If one steps accidentally on burning coals or one's hand is trapped under a heavy stone; if one falls while running then, to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: वापी कूपा सरोवर । गर्ता कडा नदीतीर । आवचितें पडे शरीर । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: विहिर, हौद, तलाव, मोठा खळगा, कडा, नदीचा कांठ, आदिमध्ये शरीर पडणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If one suddenly falls in a well, a lake, a ditch or if one falls from a cliff or from the bank of a river; when due to a lack of awareness this `all' body tumbles downwards then, to this `name' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: दुर्गाखालें कोंसळला । झाडावरुन पडला । तेणें दुःखें आक्रंदती । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: किल्ल्यावरुन खाली कोसळणे, झाडावरुन पडणे, त्या दुःखाने मोठ्याने रडणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If one is cast down into this fort covered with skin; if one falls down upon this gross body and if that Reality then lets out a loud cry of pain then, to this `I am' has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: सीतें वोठ तरकती । हात पाव टांका फुटती । चिखल्या जिव्हाळ्या लागती । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: थंडीने ओठ फुटणें, हात, पाय व टाचा यांना भेगा पडणे, हातापायांची बोटे कुजणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When the lips are cracked due to cold, or similarly the skin on the palms, hands, feet etc. are cracked; when there is dhobi's itch or a nail is bruised then, to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: अशनपानाचिये वेळे । उष्ण रसें जिव्हा पोळे । दांत कस्करे आणी हरळे । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खातापितांना गरम पदार्थ तोंडांत जाऊन जीभ पोळणे, दांतांवर दात करकरणे, दातांमध्ये फटी पडणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the burning of the tongue due to very hot food or water; when one has a sweet tooth or a tooth is broken while eating then, to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: पराधेन बाळपणीं । कुशब्दमारजाचणी । अन्नवस्त्रेंवीण आळणी । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लहानपणी परावलंबी असल्याने शिव्यांचा मारा सोसावा लागणे, अन्न वस्त्राची कमतरता असणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If a child, totally at the mercy of others, is subjected to a caning or cruel words; if one is kept without this `food' of `I am' and this covering of the `all' ("I am every- where") then one becomes a lank and miserable body and to this `name' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: सासुरवास गालोरे । ठुणके लासणें चिमोरे । आलें रुदन न धरे । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मुलींना सासुरवासामुळे गालगुच्चे, ठोसे, चिमटे, डागणे, यामुळे रडे येऊन ते न आवरणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If the daughter-in-law is insulted; if she is made to cry being pinched, beaten or burnt then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: चुकतां कान पिळिती । कां तो डोळां हिंग घालिती । सर्वकाळ धारकीं धरिती । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चूक झाली तर कान पिळतात, किंवा डोळ्यांत हिंग घालतात, सारखे धारेवर धरतात,
owis.englishMeaning: If somebody commits a mistake ("I am a body"), then he may be punished by the twisting of his ear; if one has very hot powders or asafoetida put in the eyes and if one, though being in this `time of the all', is confined to this gross body then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: नाना प्रकारीचे मार । दुर्जन मारिती अपार । दुरी अंतरे माहेर । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुष्ट लोक मारहाण करतात, मुलींना माहेर अंतरणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If there is the beating, crowding around and pushing of the ways of the `many'; if the one far from the atma (ie. ego) beats that limitless paramatma and if there is the feeling that one is far away from one's own home/*mahera then, to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world. *(guru's place)

owis.original: कर्ण नासिका विंधिलें । बळेंचि धरुन गोंधिलें । खोडी जालिया पोळविलें । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कनांत, नाकांत भोके पाडणे, जबरदस्तीने गोंदणे, थोडी चूकझाल्यावर आगीचे चटके देणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If there is the piercing of the ears or nose or tattooing; if one is scorched with hot iron bars etc., as a punishment then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: परचक्रीं धरुन नेलें । नीच यातीस दिधलें । दुर्दशा होऊन मेलें । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शत्रूच्या हल्ल्यांत पकडले जाणे, नीच यातीच्या लोकांना विकणे, अंती दुर्दशा होऊन मरणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If the enemies (the ego and sense objects) forcibly transport one to this foreign state and if they sell one off as a slave to the very lowly ("I am a body"), then one will die after great suffering and to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: नाना रोग उद्भवले । जे आध्यात्मिक बोलिले । वैद्य पंचाक्षरी आणिले । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आध्यात्मिक तापांत सांगितलेले अनेक रोग होणे, त्यांच्यासाठी वैद्य, पंचाक्षरी बोलावणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If this disease of the `many' arises ("I am a body" and the resultant `many' thoughts) then, this `speech' is mentally tormented; and if then a doctor or exorcist are brought then, to this `I am' there comes the torments of this physical existence.

owis.original: नाना वेथेचें निर्शन । व्हावया औषध दारुण । बळात्कारें देती जाण । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रोगावर उपाय म्हणून अति कडक औषधें जबरदस्तीने पाजणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When the `many' harsh medicines and methods are forcibly given in order to cure one then, to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: नाना वल्लीचे रस । काढे गर्गोड कर्कश । घेतां होये कासावीस । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरनिराळ्या वनस्पतींचे रस, काढें, वाटणें घेतांना जीव कासावीस होणें,
owis.englishMeaning: When one suffers from the `many' passions of maya; when one suffers from the taking of decoctions and very bitter medicines then, to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: ढाळ आणी उखाळ देती । पथ्य कठिण सांगती । अनुपान चुकतां विपत्ती । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जुलाबासाठी व ओकारी होण्यासाठी औषधें देणे, कठीण पथ्य करावयास सांगणे,  औषध घेण्याची रीतचुकल्याने त्रास होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When purgatives or medicines for vomiting are given; when that One is subjected to the regimens of maya; when this anecdote, `I am', is neglected then, there is misfortune and calamity and to this `name' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: फाड रक्त फांसणी । गुल्लडागांची जाचणी । तेणें दुःखें दुःखवे प्राणी । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शरीराची चिरफाड करणे, शस्त्राने शरीरांतील रक्त काढणे, तापलेल्या सळईने शरीर दाबून धरुन डागण्या देऊन भोके पाडणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the entanglements and disentanglements of attachment and likings; when there is the teasing and harassment of this `dead drunk lump'; when in the prana, that Reality is made to suffer great pain then, to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: रुचिकबिबवे घालिती । नाना दुःखें दडपे देती । सिरा तोडिती जळा लाविती । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रुईचा चीक घालणे, बिब्बा घालणे, नाना दुःखांचे आघात होणे, शिरा तोडणे, जळवा लावणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When plant extracts that irritate the skin are used against one; when `many' tortures have to be endured; when the veins are cut and leeches are stuck to the body for blood- letting then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this physical existence.

owis.original: बहु रोग बहु औषधें । सांगतां अपारें अगाधें । प्राणी दुखवे तेणे खेदें । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कितीतरी रोग व त्यांची कितीतरी औषधे आहेत. ते सांगू लागल्यास अमर्याद आहेत. त्यांच्यामुळे यातना होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the disease of the `many' and the medicines of the `many' are used on that unlimited and unfathomable Self; when in the prana, there is the suffering and torment of that Reality then, to this `I am' has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: बोलावितां पंचाक्षरी । धूरमार पीडा करी । नाना यातना चतुरीं । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एक मांत्रिक बोलाविला व त्याने धुराचा मारा केला, अशा नाना प्रकारच्या यातना आहेत त्या शहाण्यांनी आदिभूतिक समजाव्यात.
owis.englishMeaning: When the five elements within that indestructible One are invited in (ie. objectifi- cation) then, they hand out `many' cruel treatments and beatings. These `many' suffe- rings caused by the torments of this world should be known by the wise.

owis.original: दरवडे घालूनियां जना । तश्कर करिती यातना । तेणें दुःख होये मना । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चोर दरवडा घालतात व लोकांना छळतात, त्यामुळे मनाला दुःख होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When the robbers (ie. thoughts) attack and this thief (ie. mind) cause great suf- fering; when that Reality is made to suffer then, it is called the mind and to this `I am' there has come the torments of this physical existence.

owis.original: अग्नीचेनि ज्वाळे पोळे । तेणें दुःखें प्राणी हरंबळे । हानी जालियां विवळे । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आग्नीच्या ज्वाळांनी भाजणे, व्याकुळ होणे, नुकसान झाल्याने विव्हळणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When one is burnt by the flames of a fire then, that Reality tosses in pain in the prana; when that laments over the injury caused then, to this `I am' has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: नाना मंदिरें सुंदरें । नाना रत्नांचीं भांडारें । दिव्यांबरें मनोहरें । दग्ध होती ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: किती सुंदर मंदिरे, जडजवाहिरांचे साठे, सुंदर किमती वस्त्रे आग्नीने दग्ध होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When this beautiful temple of `I am' is the `many' thoughts and that treasury of *precious jewels is the `many' thoughts; then this divine and wise gets captivated by the `many' thoughts and gets burned to ashes. *(The jewels are this `word' and that thoughtless understanding)

owis.original: नाना धान्यें नाना पदार्थ । नाना पशु नाना स्वार्थ । नाना पात्रें नाना अर्थ । मनुष्ये भस्म होती ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: धान्यें, पदार्थ, पशु, घरांत साठवलेला पैसा, भांडी, वस्तु, माणसे,
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' seeds (and not this seed of creation ie. `all') and there are the `many' objects (and not the object of the `all'); there are the `many' animals and the `many' properties; there are the `many' disguises and the `many' wealths; but all these get burnt to ash by man (all these become zero in the end).

owis.original: आग्न लागला सेती । धान्यें बणव्या आणी खडकुती । युक्षदंड जळोन जाती । आकस्मात ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शेतें धान्यें, गवताच्या गंजी, धान्याच्या सालपटाचे ढिगारे, ऊस इत्यादि एकाएकी जळून जाणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If a field is set on fire and the crops and bags of grain get burnt; if the husks and sugarcane are all burnt then, to this `I am' has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: ऐसा आग्न लागला । अथवा कोणी लाविला । हानी जाली कां पोळला । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशी आग आपोआप लागली का कोणी लावली परंतु नुकसान मात्र होते, माणसेही भाजतात,
owis.englishMeaning: If a fire starts accidently or if someone purposely burns something; if one suffers loss or injury in some undertaking then, to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: ऐसे सांगतां बहुत । होती वन्हीचे आघात । तेणे दुःखें दुःखवें चित्त । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ४४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आग लागून होणारे अपघात पुष्कळ आहेत त्यामुळे माणसाच्या मनाला होणार्‍या यातना या आदिभौतिक जाणाव्यात.
owis.englishMeaning: When thoughtlessness and this `all' get burnt in the fires of knowingness (ie. the beginning of individuality; there is something outside of myself); then that Reality is the *chitta and is made to suffer its pains and to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world. *(The chitta takes the `touch' and thinks the same things over and over again; chid drops it immediately and thinks no more about it)

owis.original: हारपे विसरे आणी सांडे । नासे गाहाळे फुटे पडे । असाध्य होये कोणीकडे । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ४५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वस्तु हरवणे, विसरणे, गमावणे, सडणे, गहाळ होणे, फुटणे, पडणे, परत मिळणे अशक्य होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When one losses, forgets and leaves aside this `I am'; when one destroys, wanders astray from, breaks and falls down from this `I am' then, to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: प्राणी रथानभ्रष्ट जालें । नाना पशूतें चुकलें । कन्यापुत्र गाहाळले । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ४६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणूस स्थानभ्रष्ट होणे किंवा पदभ्रष्ट होणे, जनावरे गायब होणे, मुले-मुली हरवणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When in the prana there appears this place of the fallen and confused (ie. body consciousness) then, the `many' domesticated animals may get lost or one's children may leave one and go away and to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: तश्कर अथवा दावेदार । आवचिता करिती संव्हार । लुटिती घरें नेती खिल्लार । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ४७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चोरांनी किंवा शत्रूनीं एकाएकी धाड घालणे, संहार करणे, घरे लुटणे, जनावरे पळविणे,
owis.englishMeaning: Robbers or enemies may suddenly attack and cause great destruction; they may plunder your house and take away your animals, then to this `name' there comes the torments of this worldly existence.

owis.original: नाना धान्यें केळी कापिती । पानमळां मीठ घालिती । ऐसे नाना आघात करिती । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ४८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शेतांतील धान्यें कापून नेणे, केळी तोडणे, पानमळ्यांत मीठ घालून नासधूस करणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When the `many' crops or banana trees are deliberately cut down; when salt is placed under the betel trees to kill them; when such are the `many' crimes perpetrated then, to this `I am' there comes the torments of this world.

owis.original: मैंद उचले खाणोरी । सुवर्णपंथी भुररेकरी । ठकु सिंतरु वरपेकरी । वरपा घालिती ॥ ४९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लुटारु, उचले, घर खणुन चोरी करणारे, किमयागार, भुरळ घालणारे ठग, लुच्चे, फसविणारे, दरवडेखोर, आदि लोकांनी धाड घालणे, लुटणे व फसविणे,
owis.englishMeaning: There is the murderer of the greedy traveller (the ego kills the jiva); he is the alchemist (the one who seeks to turn base metal to gold), the hypnotist, the deceiver and accuser (all these are the mind).

owis.original: गठीछोडे द्रव्य सोडिती । नाना आळंकार काढिती । नाना वस्तु मूषक नेती । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ५० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गाठोडी पळविणार्‍यांनी ती पळवून दागदागिने लांबविणे, उंदरांनी अनेक वस्तु पळविणे,
owis.englishMeaning: He is the thief who steals the wealth of the `many' ("It all belongs to me"); he snatches away all the finery of the `many'; he takes away the objects of the `many' due to his ignorance and then, to this `name' has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: वीज पडे हिंव पडे । प्राणी प्रंजनी सापडे । कां तो माहापुरीं बुडे । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ५१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंगावर वीज पडणे, अति थंडी पडणे, मोठ्या पावसांत सापडणे, महापुरांत बुडणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When lightening strikes and coldness falls (ie. the flash of the mind says, "This is such and such" and the roar of thunder, "I am so and so"; it gives name and form to the nameless and formless and everything has become gross/cold); when the one in the prana gets caught in heavy rain (ie. desires falling from the clouds of ignorance); when that atma gets drowned in this great flood of maya then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this worldly existence.

owis.original: भोवरे वळणें आणी धार । वोसाणें लाटा अपार । वृश्र्चिक गोंबी आजगर । वाहोन जाती ॥ ५२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नदीच्या प्रवाहांतभोवरे, वळणे, धार, पुरांतुन वहात येणार्‍या वस्तु, म्हणजे लाकडे वगैरे, मोठ्या लाटा, विंचु, गोमा, अजगर यां बरोबर वाहुन जाणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When that limitless paramatma is this *river in flood, then there are whirlpools, great crashing waves and vicious insects, scorpions and snakes of desires being carried along in it. *(This river of samsar)

owis.original: तयामध्ये प्राणी सांपडला । खडकींबेटीं आडकला । बुडत बुडत वांचला । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ५३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यांत सापडणे, वहात वहात एखाद्या खडकावर किंवा बेटावर अडकणे, बुडता बुडता वाचणे,
owis.englishMeaning: Then in that Reality that One is trapped in the prana and in this crowded brawl it takes a definite form. And if though drowning it struggles on without trying to reach the shore then, to this `I am' there comes the torments of this worldly existence.

owis.original: मनासारिखा नसे संसार । कुरुप कर्कश स्त्री क्रूर । विधवा कन्या मूर्ख पुत्र । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ५४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कुरुप, कर्कश, क्रूर स्वभावाची बायको मिळणे, मुलगी विधवा होणे, मुलगा मूर्ख असणे,
owis.englishMeaning: Then the mind is continuously lost in samsar and this women (prakruti) assumes a false form (a wife to her husband) and talks loudly and cruelly (not the soft and gentle `I am'). Her daughter becomes a widow (ie. has lost her purush also) and her son is stupid (ie. has no vivek) and to this `I am' there has come the torments of this worldly life.

owis.original: भूत पिशाच्य लागलें । आंगावरुन वारें गेलें । अबद्ध मंत्रे प्राणी चळलें । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ५५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भूत, पिशाच्च लागणे, अंगावरुन वारे जाणे, मंत्राचा जप चुकल्याचा भ्रम होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the elements (objectification) and this evil spirit called the ego then, one runs from this `all' body towards the objects; and when due to the irrelevant and self-willed mantra ("I am Mr. so and so") one moves about in the prana, then to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: ब्राह्मणसमंध शरीरीं । बहुसाल पीडा करी । शनेश्र्वराचा धोका धरी । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ५६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एखदा ब्रह्मसमंध शरीरांत शिरुन बरीच वर्षे त्रास देणे, शनीची वाईट दशा येणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When this `all' has the pride of knowing ("I know this and that") then it brings troubles for `many' years; and when Saturn's return brings great fear then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: नाना ग्रहे काळवार । काळतिथी घातचंद्र । काळवेळ घातनक्षत्र । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ५७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: इतर ग्रहांची वाईट दशा येणे, काळवार, काळतिथि, चंद्राचे असणारी काळवेळ, घातनक्षत्र,
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the `many' undesirable times, inauspicious positions of the moon, planets and the stars; when there is this time of great calamity and death then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: सिंक पिंगळा आणी पाली । वोखटें होला काक कलाली । चिंता काजळी लागली । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ५८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शिंकेचा अपशकुन, पालीची चुकचुक, पिंगळा, कावळा, होला यापाखरांचा अपशकुन, असल्या अपशकुनांनी मनांत काळजीचा काळोख पसरणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When one believes in bad omens, like an inopportune sneeze, the hoot of an owl, the sound of lizard or the call of a crow or other `evil' birds (ie. all kinds of superstitions); when these create worry and misgivings in the mind then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world. 26siddharameshwara maharaj- sadesati means seven and a half. According to Hindu astrology it is a period of misfortune or Saturn's return which lasts for seven and a half years. However the real misfortune is the human body that measures seven and a half vita (the distance from the thumb-tip to the tip of the little finger when the hand if fully extended).

owis.original: दिवटा सरवदा भाकून गेला । अंतरीं धोका लागला । दुःस्वप्नें जाजावला । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ५९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दिवटा म्हणजे रात्री मशालीच्या प्रकाशांत भविष्य सांगत फिरणारा, व भविष्य सांगणारा सरवटा, हे वाईट भविष्य सांगून गेले म्हणुन मनाला धसका बसणे त्यामुळे वाईट स्वप्ने पडून भिति वाटणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When some fortune teller wandering in the street tells of some misfortune to come and this causes fear; or when one has a very bad dream which creates anxiety then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: भालु भुंके स्वान रडे । पाली अंगावरी पडे । नाना चिन्हें चिंता पवाडे । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ६० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोल्हेकुई, कुत्र्यांचे रडणे, पाल अंगावर पडणे, अशा अनेक अपशकुनांनी मनाला फार काळजी वाटणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If a fox or dog howls and then some doubt or misgiving falls upon this `all' body; if these `many' unwanted omens enter the mind and create worry then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: बाहेरी निघतां अपशकुन । नाना प्रकारें विछिन्न । तेणें गुणें भंगे मन । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ६१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: घराबाहेर पडले की नाना प्रकारचे विचित्र अपशकुन होऊन मन उदास होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If one is setting out on a journey and some bad omen appears; if one believes in the `many' ways and `many' divisions then, that Reality is broken by the mixing of the gunas (ie. imagination) and there is the worldly mind and to this `name' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: प्राणी बंदी सांपडला । यातने वरपडा जाला । नाना दुःखें दुःखवला । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ६२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कैदेंत पडणे, तेथे अनेक प्रकारच्या यातना भोगावयास लागणे, अनेक दुःखांनी कष्टी होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If in the prana one is thrown into bondage and subjected to atrocities then, there are `many' sufferings and to this `I am' has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: प्राणी राजदंड पावत । जेरबंद चाबुक वेत । दरेमार तळवेमार । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ६३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: राजाकडून शिक्षा होणे, घोड्याच्या काढण्या, चाबूक, छड्या यांचा मार मिळणे, दरींत लोटून देणे, तापलेल्या तव्यावर उभे करणे,
owis.englishMeaning: If in the prana one is punished by the *King and bound to this feeble, powerless body and beaten with His cane; if one tumbles down the mountain-side to the bottom like a creature in this river of samsar then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world. *(The King is the atma purush and the one who forgets Him has to suffer the law of karma)

owis.original: कोरडे पारंब्या फोक । बहु प्रकारें अनेक । बहु ताडिती आदिभूतिक । या नाव बोलिजे ॥ ६४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोरडे म्हणजे चामड्याचा चाबूक, झाडाच्या पारंब्या, फोक म्हणजे झाडाची सालपटे, यांनी मारणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the ways of the `many' and the numerous different shapes and forms then, one may get flogged with a whip, a stick or a long root. These `many' punishments bring the torments of this world and therefore this `I am' should be `spoken'.

owis.original: मोघरीमार बुधलेमार । चौखरुन डंगारमार । बुक्या गचांड्या गुडघेमार । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ६५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जाड सोट्यासारख्या मुदगलाने मारणे, दारुच्या बुधल्यास बांधुन आग लावून मारणे, चारी बाजूंनी ताणून बडगे हाणुन मारणे, गुद्दे मारणे, गचांड्या मारणे, गुडगह्यांनी मारणे,
owis.englishMeaning: That One may be punished in various ways. A wooden peg may be forced into the anus or one may be tied to a barrel of wine and then burnt; or one's hands and feet may be stretched apart and punched, beaten and kicked. If this happens then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: लाता तपराखा सेणमार । कानखडे दगडमार । नाना प्रकारींचे मार । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ६६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लाथा मारणे, चपराका मारणे, शेणमारा करणे, कानांत खडे खुपसणे, दगडांनी मारणे, असे नाना प्रकारचे मार भोगावे लागणे,
owis.englishMeaning: One may be kicked, slapped or have dung thrown on this body; one may have pebbles put in the ears and then they may be twisted. For these ways of the `many' one has to rush here and there, then one may get punished or feel exuberance, but to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: टांगणें टिपर्‍या पिछोडे । बेडी बुधनाल कोलदंडे । रक्षणनिग्रह चहूंकडे । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ६७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: टांगणें, चाप लावणें, दोन्ही हात मागे खेचून बांधणे, बेड्या घालणे, झाडाच्या बुंध्यावर नालाप्रमाणे वाकायला लावून मारणे. कोलदांडे घालणे, इकडे तिकडे हालू न देणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When one is hanged with one's hands tied behind one's back; when chains are put around one's feet; when one is tied around a tree and beaten; when one is put in this wooden trap and kept under constant guard then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: नाकवणी चुनवणी । मीठवणी रायवणी । गुळवण्याची जाचणी । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ६८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चुन्याचे पाणी, मिठाचे पाणी, मोहरीचे पाणी, गुळाचे पाणी नाकांत, घशांत किंवा कानांत ओतल्याने यातना होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When bitter liquids or acidic things, such as lime water, salt water, mustard water or even jaggery water are poured in the nose then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: जळामध्यें बुचकुळिती । हस्तीपुढें बांधोन टाकिती । हाकिती छळिती यातायाती । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ६९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पाण्यांत बुचकळणे, हातपाय बांधून हत्तीपुढे टाकणे, जनावराप्रमाणे फटके मारुन हांकणे, छळ करणे, उगाच कष्ट देणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When one is again and again forced under water; when one is bound and thrown in front of an elephant; when one is put to yoke like a bull and beaten over and over then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: कर्णछेद घ्राणछेद । हस्तछेद पादछेद । जिव्हाछेद अधरछेद । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ७० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कान, नाक, हात, पाय, जीभ, ओठ तोडून टाकणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When the ears, nose, hands, feet, tongue or lips are pierced with hooks* then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world. *(Regarded by some as a spiritual practice)

owis.original: तीरमार सुळीं देती । नेत्र वृषण काढिती । नखोनखी सुया मारिती । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ७१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बाणांचा मार देणे, सुळी देणे, डोळे काढणे, वृषण काढणे, बोटांच्या नखांमध्ये सुया टोंचणें,
owis.englishMeaning: When he is placed on the gallows; when an arrow is fired at him; when his eyes and testicles are taken out and his nails are pierced by needles then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: पारड्यामध्यें घालणें । कां कडेलोट करणें । कां भांड्यामुखें उडवणें । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ७२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पारड्यामध्ये घालणे, कडेलोट करणे, तोफेच्या तोंडी बांधुन उडविणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When one is cast into grievous trouble or treated with contempt; when one is ridiculed, scorned and quarrelled with then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: कानीं खुंट्या आदळिती । अपानीं मेखा मारिती । खाल काढून टाकिती । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ७३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कानांत खुंट्या ठोकणे, गुदद्वारांत मेखा मारणे, अंगाचे कातडे सोलणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When one is skinned or wooden pegs are put into the ears or the lower orifice then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: भोत आणी बोटबोटी । अथवा गळ घालणें कंठीं । सांडस लाऊन आटाटी । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ७४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पोत्यांत भरुन मारणे, बोटें ठेचून टाकणे, गळ्याला गळ लावणे, तापलेल्या चिमट्याने वृषण किंवा स्तन डागणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When one is forced into this skin and given fingers and toes and made to endure and suffer so many forms of harassment and strenuous efforts then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: सिसें पाजणें वीष देणें । अथवा सिरछेद करणें । कां पायातळीं घालणें । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ७५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उकळलेले शिसे पाजणे,जालिम विष पाजणे, शोकेम उडविणे, अंगावर माणसे नाचवून मारणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When the mind is forced to swallow deception and made to take the poison (maharaj- this world is a slow poison); when one removes their head and buries it underneath their feet (one does not use vivek); then to this `I am' there has come the torments of this worldly existence.

owis.original: सरड मांजरें भरिती । अथवा फांसीं नेऊन देती । नानापरी पीडा करिती । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ७६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंगावरील कपड्यांत सरडे सोडणे, बंद खोलींत ठेऊन पिसाळलेले मांजर सोडणे,  फाशी देणे, नानाप्रकारे पीडा देणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When a large reptile is put into the pants of a man or a person in kept in a closed room with an angry cat or one is taken to the gallows (siddharameshwar maharaj- every moment you are standing on the gallows); these ways of the `many' cause so much suffering and to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: स्वानप्रळये व्याघ्रप्रळये । भूतप्रळये सुसरीप्रळये । शस्त्रप्रळये वीझप्रळये । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ७७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कुत्री, वाघ, भुतेंखेतें, सुसरी, शस्त्रे, विजा यांचा अतिरेक होऊन जीविताची हानी होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there is ruin and destruction by this dog (it wanders around with its tongue hanging out, always looking for something); when there is ruin and destruction by the tiger (maya rides on a tiger); when there is ruin and destruction by the elements (objectification); where there is ruin and destruction by the crocodile (ego); when there is ruin and destruction by the presence of one's own power (the pride of arts and skills) and when there is the ruin and destruction by the beauty of a woman then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: सीरा वोढून घेती । टेंमें लाऊन भाजिती । ऐशा नाना विपत्ती । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ७८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंगावरील शिरा तोडणे, जळत्या टेंभ्यांनी चटके देणे, भाजून काढणे, नाना यातना भोगणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When the veins and arteries are pulled out or a person is scorched by the naked flame of a torch; when such are the cruelties of the `many' then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: मनुष्यहानी वित्तहानी । वैभवहानी महत्वहानी । पशुहानी पदार्थहानी । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ७९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मनुष्य, द्रव्य, वैभव, मोठेपणा, जनावरें, व चीजवस्तु यांची हानी होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When one suffers the loss of one's ability; when one suffers the loss of the known/pra- kruti; when one suffers the loss of one's grandeur (of the `all'); when one suffers the loss of one's importance; when one suffers the loss of one's animals or when suffers the loss of this `all' then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: बाळपणीं मरे माता । तारुण्यपणीं मरे कांता । वृद्धपणीं मृत्य सुता । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ८० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बाळपणी आई मरणे, तरुणपणी बायको मरणे, म्हातारपणी मुलगा मरणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When one's mother dies in childhood; or one's wife dies when one is young; or one's daughter dies when one is old then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: दुःख दारिद्र्य आणी रुण । विदेशपळणी नागवण । आपदा अनुपति कदान्न । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ८१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दुःख, दारिद्र्य, कर्ज, परदेशी पळून जाणे, लूट होऊन नागवले जाणे, संकटें येणे, अंगावर जड वस्तु पडणे, वाईट अन्न खावे लागणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there is pain, poverty and the `great debt' (to forget one's own true wealth and borrow from this to make a gross world and take oneself to be a gross body) then, there is the plundering of this `state beyond'; then there is misfortune and calamities and one eats only the lowest food (and not this divine `food' of `I am') and to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: आकांत वाखाप्रळये । युध्य होतां पराजये । जिवलगांचा होये क्षये । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ८२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कॉलर्‍याच्या साथीने अनेक माणसे मरणे, युद्धांत पराभव होणे, जिवलगंचा मृत्यु होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there are great tragedies and destruction; when there is victory for another in this war (with the ego/ravana or these objects/kauravas) and then there is the loss of that One most dear (Self) and to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: कठीणकाळ आणी दुष्काळ । साशंक आणी वोखटी वेळ । उद्वेग चिंतेचे हळाळ । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ८३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कठीण काळी दुष्काळ येणे, मनांत भीति असतांना वाईट वेळ येणे, उद्वेग उत्पन्न होणे, काळजीने जीवाचे हाल होणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this difficult time and this time of famine/empty wanting and this divine `food' is not understood; when there are suspicious, doubts and fearful periods; when there is anxiety and uneasiness and the disquiet of worries then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: घाणा चरखीं सिरकला । चाकाखालें सांपडला । नाना वन्हींत पडिला । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ८४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: घाण्यांत किंवा चरकांत शिरुन चाकाखाली सापडणे, निरनिराळ्या प्रकारच्या आगींत पडणे,
owis.englishMeaning: To be forced under the grinding wheel of this crusher (of samsar); to fall under the ever-turning wheel (of samsar); to fall into this fire of the `many' then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: नाना शस्त्रें भेदिला । नाना स्वापदीं भक्षिला । नाना बंदीं पडिला । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ८५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक शस्त्रांनी अवयव तुटणे, नाना श्वापदानी खाणे, अनेक लोकांच्या कैदेंत अडकणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When one is divided and changed by the powers of the `many' learnings; when one is consumed by one's station/office in the `many'; when one falls into bondage in the `many' then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: नाना कुवासें निर्बुजे । नाना अपमानें लाजे । नाना शोकें प्राणी झिजे । या नाव आदिभूतिक॥ ८६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वाईट जागी रहावे लागणे, निरनिराळ्या प्रकारच्या अपमानाने लाजिरवाणे होणे, नाना दुःखांनी खंगून जाणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When one is dazzled or scared by the supports of the `many'; when one is shamed and disregarded by the `many'; when one wastes away in the prana due to the sorrows in the `many' then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of this world.

owis.original: ऐसे सांगतां अपार । आहेत दुःखाचे डोंगर । श्रोतीं जाणावा विचार । आदिभूतिकाचा ॥ ८७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असे वर्णन केलेले दुःखांचें पुष्कळ डोंगर आहेत. ते सर्व सांगता येणे येथे शक्य नाही. परंतु येथे जे सांगितलेले आहेत त्यावरुन श्रोत्यांनी आदिभौतिक तापाचा विचार समजून घ्यावा.
owis.englishMeaning: In this way, that One who is immeasurable has become the one with a mountain of suffering. Therefore the good listener should know that thoughtless Self that has become these torments of this world. .

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: मागां बोलिला आध्यात्मिक । त्या उपरी आदिभूतिक । आतां बोलिजेल आदिदैविक । तो सावध ऐका ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपल्या शुभ व अशुभ कर्मांमुळे स्वर्ग व नरकयातना भोगाव्या लागतात. त्यांना आदिदैविक ताप असे म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Previous to this `speech' there are the torments of the mind and upon this `speech' has come the torments of the outside world. Now forget everything and if that atma remains alert then, the torments of destiny will be made into this `speech'. Therefore listen.

owis.original: शुभाशुभ कर्मानें जना । देहांतीं येमयातना । स्वर्ग नर्क भोग नाना । या नाव आदिदैविक ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसांना त्यांच्या चांगल्यावाईट कर्मांनी मरणानंतर यमयातना व स्वर्ग असे अनेक भोग भोगावे लागतात. त्यांना आदिदैविकताप म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: People, due to their good and bad actions, have to face the judgment of yama, the God of death. Then there are the experiences of the `many' heavens and hells and to this `I am' there has come the torments caused by destiny or fate. (If we live and die taking ourself to be the body then rebirth is unavoidable. And the birth we take will be dictated by our previous actions/karma. These previous actions will make that life a heaven or a hell; maharaj- every mind is a world)

owis.original: नाना दोष नाना पातकें । मदांधपणें अविवेकें । केलीं परी तें दुखदायकें । येमयातना भोगविती ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणूस मदांध होऊन अविनाशी बनतो व अविचारानें तो अनेक दोष व पातकें करतो. तीं पातकें अंती दुःखदायक होऊन त्यास यमयातना भोगावयास लावतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The faults of the `many' and the crimes of the `many' are due to the intoxication of pride and a lack of vivek. When these have been made then, that Reality has to be endure the judgment of yama, as the giver of suffering (otherwise by the `many' good actions, yama will be the giver of the `many' pleasures of heaven to that Reality. But whether your next life is perceived as heaven or hell, still that Reality is caught in illusion).

owis.original: आंगबळें द्रव्यबळें । मनुष्यबळें राजबळें । नाना सामर्थ्याचेनि बळें । अकृत्य करिती ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणुस अंगबळाने, पैशाच्या बळाने, मनुष्यबळाने अगर राजबळाने अशा वेगवेगळ्या शक्तींच्या बळावर वाईट कर्मे करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There is this power of the `all' and there are the powers of the `many' manifested forms. This first power is in the possession of the King/atma purush and the other powers are in the possession of each man (ie. he creates `many' concepts and imagines `many' things). And if this power of the `all' becomes these `many' powers then, that One's actions and conduct will be improper.

owis.original: नीती सांडूनियां तत्वता । करुं नये तेंचि करितां । येमयातना भोगितां । जीव जाये ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नीतिला सोडून करु नये ते माणसे करितात. त्यामुळेमृत्युनंतर मग यमयातना भोगाव्या लागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If proper conduct (`He does') is left aside then, that Reality does that which it should not do ("I am doing and I am the enjoyer"). This leads to the death of the jiva and the suffering of yama's judgment.

owis.original: डोळे झांकून स्वार्थबुद्धी । नाना अभिळाश कुबुद्धी । वृत्ति भूमिसिमा सांधी । द्रव्य दारा पदार्थ ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अति स्वार्थबुद्धीने माणसे अति लोभाने अंध बनून जमीनीची हद्द वाढविणे, दुसर्‍याचे द्रव्य, बायको,वस्तु पळविणे,
owis.englishMeaning: When one's eyes are covered over with a selfish intellect then, there are `many' selfish thoughts and this knowing vritti seeks to acquire this world of wealth, woman and objects.

owis.original: मातलेपणें उन्मत्त । जीवघात कुटुंबघात । अप्रमाण क्रिया करीत । म्हणौन येमयातना ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नेहमी मस्तवालपणे उन्मत्तासारखे वागणे, जीवाचा नाश करणे, कुटुंबाचा नाश करणे, समाजविध्वंसक कर्मे करणे, असे करणरांना यमयातना भोगाव्या लागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to its intoxication of pride, the jiva and its family are killed doing the `many' actions that have no authority (ie. "I do" and not the understanding `He is doing everything') and therefore they must face the judgment of yama.

owis.original: मर्यादा सांडूनि चालती । ग्रामा दंडी ग्रामाधिपती । देशा दंडी देशाधिपती । नीति न्याय सांडितां ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नीतिन्यायास सोडून वागल्यास तर गावाचा अधिपती गावाला दंड करतो. देशाचा राजा देशाला दंड करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When restraint is not observed in one's behaviour then, in that village, the master of the village punishes and in the provinces it is the ruler who punishes the crimes committed.

owis.original: देशाधिपतीस दंडिता रावो । रायास दंडिता देवो । राजा न करितां नीतिन्यावो । म्हणौन येमयातना ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देशाच्या स्वामीला राजा शासन करतो. राजा नीतिन्यायाने वागत नसेल तर राजाला देव शासन करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Even the ruler is punished by the King (atma) who in turn is punished by the god of death, if he is not acting according to His own justice (ie. not being the King).

owis.original: अनीतीनें स्वार्थ पाहे । राजा पापी होऊन राहे । राज्या अंती नर्क आहे । म्हणौनिां ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जो राजा अनीतिने स्वार्थ साधतो, तो पापी बनतो. त्याचे पाप वाढत जाऊन तो मेला की त्याला नरकवास भोगावा लागतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then due to injustice there is selfishness and that King becomes a sinner and stays as a jiva. Then His kingdom comes to an end and this is a hell. (At this very moment heaven ie. `I am' and hell are here; it all depends on who you take yourself to be)

owis.original: राजा सांडिती राजनीति । तयास येम गांजिती । येम नीति सांडितां धावती । देवगण ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: राजाने नीति सोडली तर त्यास यम शासन करतो. पण यमाने नीतिचे पालन केले नाही तर देवगण यमास शासन करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If the King lets slip the conduct of the King (ie. the King should sit on His throne and by His power everything should go on naturally), then yama roars at him. And if yama commits an injustice, then the Leader of the gods (paramatma) comes running.

owis.original: ऐसी मर्यादा लाविली देवें । म्हणौन नीतीनें वर्तावें । नीती न्याय सांडितां भोगावें । येमयातनेसी ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवाने अशी ही मर्यादा घालून दिली आहे. म्हणून सर्वांनी नीतिने वागावे. नीतिन्यायाने न वागल्यास यमयातना भोगाव्या लागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Such is the rule established by God. Therefore one should stay here exercising proper justice. If there is a lack of justice, then one has to suffer the judgment of yama. (Justice is to understand, `I am the Self/King')

owis.original: देवें प्रेरिले येम । म्हणौन आदिदैविक नाम । तृतीय ताप दुर्गम । येमयातनेचा ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव यमाला प्रेरित करुन त्याच्याद्वारे जीवाला हे भोग भोगावयास लावतो. म्हणून यास आदिदैविक ताप असे नाव आहे. ह्या यमयातना अति दुःसह व दुखद आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: If God sends yama then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of destiny. This is the third torment and this judgment of yama is hard to pass over.

owis.original: येमदंड येमयातना । शास्त्रीं बोलिले प्रकार नाना । तो भोग कदापि चुकेना । या नाव आदिदैविक ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शास्त्रामध्ये यमदंड व यमयातना यांचे अनंत प्रकार सांगितले आहेत. हे यमयातनेचे भोग कधिच चुकविता येत नाहीत. म्हणून यास आदिदैविक असे नाव आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: There is the judgment of yama and the punishment of yama when this `speech' that is within the shasthras (neti, neti) becomes the ways of the `many'. Then that atma cannot avoid the `many' suffering and to this `I am' there has come the torments of destiny.

owis.original: येमयातनेचे खेद । शास्त्रीं बोलिले विशद । शेरीरीं घालून अप्रमाद । नाना प्रकारें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणूस जी नाना प्रकारची दुष्कृत्ये करतो त्यांचे सगळे दोष त्याच्या सूक्ष्म शरीरांत साठवले जातात. त्या दोषामप्रमाणे त्याला यमयातना भोगाव्या लागतात. शास्त्रामध्ये सर्व वर्णन केले आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Either there are these torments of yama's judgment or there is this clear `speech' within the shasthras (ie. when you understand, `not this, not that', then this `speech' is there). This `speech' is established when the ways of the `many' becomes careful and attentive (when there is vivek).

owis.original: पापपुण्याचीं शरीरें । स्वर्गीं असती कळीवरें । त्यांत घालून नाना प्रकारें । पापपुण्य भोगविती ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मरणोत्तर लोकांत पापपुण्याची शरीरे असतात. मनुष्य मेल्यानंतर त्याचा सूक्ष्म देह त्याच्या पापपुण्यानुसार त्याच्या शरीरांत घालून मग त्याला पापाची व पुण्याची फळे भोगावी लागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: But if this `all' body accumulates sins and merits then, though being in heaven, there is the appearance of this corpse (ie. this gross body is but an appearance within this `I am' of knowledge). When these ways of the `many' have been established within that atma then, the atma has to endure the results of the sins and merits incurred (then the atma has to go wherever imagination leads it). (This world is heaven if you understand, otherwise it is the hells of ignorance)

owis.original: नाना पुण्यें नाना विळास । नाना दोषें यातना कर्कश । शास्त्रीं बोलिले अविश्र्वास । मानूंच नये ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याच्या पदरी पुष्कळ पुण्य त्याला ते संपेपर्यंत स्वर्गसुख व ज्याच्या पदरी पाप पुष्कळ त्याला पुष्कळ नरकयातनांचे दुःख व यातना भोगाव्या लागतात. असे शास्त्रांत सांगितले आहे. ते खोटे मानू नये.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to the merits of the `many' there is the `many' wanton plays and pleasures and due to the sins of the `many' there are cruel punishments. This `speech' within the shasthras should therefore not be regarded as untrue (ie. seek out this `speech' by leaving the `many' thoughts of good or bad).

owis.original: वेदाज्ञेनें न चालती । हरिभक्ती न करिती । त्यास येमयातना करिती । या नाव आदिदैविक ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जे वेदाज्ञेनुसा वागत नाहीत, जे हरिभक्ती करत नाहीत त्यांना यमयातना भोगाव्या लागतात. यास आदिदैविक ताप म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If this knowledge of the *vedas is never present then, there has been no devotion to hari and that atma will receive the punishment of yama. Then to this `I am' there will come the torments of destiny. *(The purpose of the vedas is to reveal this knowledge of `I am')

owis.original: अक्षोभ नर्कीं उदंड जीव । जुनाट किडे करिती रवरव । बांधोन टाकिती हातपाय । या नाव आदिदैविक ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अक्षोभ नावाच्या नरकांत अनेक जुने किडे वळवळ करीत असतात. पापी मनुष्याला यम त्यामध्ये हातपाय बांधुन टाकतो. यास आदिदैविक ताप म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that unfathomable paramatma has become a jiva in hell and it is old and infested with worms. Then it is confined to only that which it can lay its hands upon (ie. body consciousness) and to this `I am' there has come the torments of destiny (ie. the results of our past thoughts and past actions are unavoidable. How we meet them; the understanding with which we meet them, is in our hands).

owis.original: उदंड पैस लाहान मुख । कुंभाकार कुंड येक । दुर्गंधी उकाडा कुंभपाक । या नाव आदिदैविक ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांही पापी जीवांना कुंभपाक नावाच्या नरकांत टाकतात. कुंभपाक म्हणजे लहान तोंडाचे पण आत मोठी जागा असलेले मडक्यासारखे कुंड. ह्या कुंडांत फार उकाडा व दुर्गधी असते. याला आदिदैविक ताप म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: That vast emptiness has become this pot (a small gross body) with a small opening created by the potter. Inside it there is hot and stinking undigested food and to this `I am' there has come the torments of destiny.

owis.original: तप्त भूमिका ताविती । जळत स्वंभ पोटाळविती । नाना सांडस लाविती । या नाव आदिदैविक ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जीवाला तापलेल्या जमिनीवर भाजतात. जळत असलेला लाकडी खांब पोटावर फिरवतात. अनेक चाप लावतात. यास आदिदैविक ताप म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: In this theatrical disguise, tremendous anger and passions are aroused. When you support and cherish this `hot pillar' (ie. at this moment it is a dead body, the power makes it warm and move) in the hurried and confusing `many' then, to this `I am' there has come the torments of destiny.

owis.original: येमदंडाचे उदंड मार । यातनेची सामग्री अपार । भोग भोगिती पापी । या नाव आदिदैविक ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: यमाच्या शिक्षेमध्ये मार देण्याचे पुष्कळ प्रकार आहेत. यातना देण्याची साधने पुष्कळ आहेत. पापी मनुष्यांना त्यांच्या पापाच्या यातना भोगाव्या लागतात.
